<ix:exclude><p id="xdx_23A_zGUtQe5TxrO8" style="font: bold 12pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 4.1pt 16.05pt 0 4.25pt; text-align: center">CENTRAL PUERTO S.A.</p></ix:exclude>

<ix:exclude><p id="xdx_233_zf1AJtP0Ld16" style="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0 20.25pt 0 0; text-align: justify">&#160;</p></ix:exclude>

<ix:exclude><p id="xdx_23A_zcSPF0ooQNG3" style="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0 20.25pt 0 0; text-align: justify">&#160;</p></ix:exclude>

<p style="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0.05pt 20.1pt 0 0; text-align: justify">&#160;</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0.05pt 20.1pt 0 8.35pt; text-align: justify">According to Resolution 1, the
approved remuneration system would be of transitional application and until the following would be defined and gradually implemented:
regulatory mechanisms aimed at reaching an autonomous, competitive and sustainable operation that allows for freedom of contract between
supply and demand; and a technical, economical and operative functioning for the integration of different generation technologies so as
to guarantee a reliable and cost effective system.</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0; text-align: justify">&#160;</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0 20.1pt 0 8.35pt; text-align: justify">The following were the main changes
introduced by Resolution 1 in connection with Resolution 19:</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0 20.1pt 0 0; text-align: justify">&#160;</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0 20.1pt 0 8.35pt; text-align: justify">Energy Sale:</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0 20.1pt 0 0; text-align: justify">&#160;</p>

<table cellpadding="0" cellspacing="0" style="font: 11pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; width: 100%; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0"><tr style="vertical-align: top">
<td style="width: 9.4pt"/><td style="width: 18.05pt"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#8211;</span></td><td style="text-align: justify; padding-right: 20.15pt"><span style="font-size: 10pt">The price of energy generated by thermal power stations
was reduced. Therefore, the price for energy generated with natural gas was of 4 USD/MWh and 7 USD/MWh for energy generated with liquid
fuel.</span></td></tr></table>

<p style="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0 20.15pt 0 0; text-align: justify">&#160;</p>

<table cellpadding="0" cellspacing="0" style="font: 11pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; width: 100%; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0"><tr style="vertical-align: top">
<td style="width: 9.45pt"/><td style="width: 18pt"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#8211;</span></td><td style="text-align: justify; padding-right: 20.15pt"><span style="font-size: 10pt">The price of energy operated by thermal power stations
was reduced. Therefore, the price for energy operated with any fuel was of 1.4 USD/MW.</span></td></tr></table>

<p style="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0 20.15pt 0 0; text-align: justify">&#160;</p>

<table cellpadding="0" cellspacing="0" style="font: 11pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; width: 100%; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0"><tr style="vertical-align: top">
<td style="width: 9.4pt"/><td style="width: 18.05pt"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#8211;</span></td><td style="text-align: justify; padding-right: 20.2pt"><span style="font-size: 10pt">The price for energy generated from non-conventional
energy sources (renewable energies) was fixed at 28 USD/MWh.</span></td></tr></table>

<p style="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0; text-align: justify">&#160;</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0 20.1pt 0 8.35pt; text-align: justify">Power Sale:</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0 20.1pt 0 0; text-align: justify">&#160;</p>

<table cellpadding="0" cellspacing="0" style="font: 11pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; width: 100%; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0"><tr style="vertical-align: top">
<td style="width: 9.4pt"/><td style="width: 18.05pt"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#8211;</span></td><td style="text-align: justify; padding-right: 20.15pt"><span style="font-size: 10pt">DIGO price (established by Resolution 19) went from
7,000 USD/MW-month during the twelve months of the year to 7,000 USD/MW-month the six months of higher seasonal demand for electrical
energy (December, January, February, June, July and August) and to 5,500 USD/MW-month the remaining months of the year (March, April,
May, September, October and November).</span></td></tr></table>

<p style="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0; text-align: justify">&#160;</p>

<table cellpadding="0" cellspacing="0" style="font: 11pt/98% Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; width: 100%; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0"><tr style="vertical-align: top">
<td style="width: 9.45pt"/><td style="width: 18pt"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#8211;</span></td><td style="text-align: justify; padding-right: 20.05pt"><span style="font-size: 10pt">Some minimum values of offered availability are
reduced. Its compliance was subject to the foregoing prices.</span></td></tr></table>

<p style="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0; text-align: justify">&#160;</p>

<table cellpadding="0" cellspacing="0" style="font: 11pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; width: 100%; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0"><tr style="vertical-align: top">
<td style="width: 9.45pt"/><td style="width: 18pt"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#8211;</span></td><td style="text-align: justify; padding-right: 20.3pt"><span style="font-size: 10pt">A weighting factor was fixed for the foregoing prices,
between 1 and 0.7, depending on the use factor of the twelve months previous to each month of the transaction.</span></td></tr></table>

<p style="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0 20.3pt 0 0; text-align: justify">&#160;</p>

<table cellpadding="0" cellspacing="0" style="font: bold 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; width: 100%; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0"><tr style="vertical-align: top">
<td style="width: 8.35pt"/><td style="width: 13.6pt">f)</td><td style="text-align: justify">Resolution No. 31/2020 of the Secretariat of Energy</td></tr></table>

<p style="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0; text-align: justify"><b>&#160;</b></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0 20.1pt 0 8.35pt; text-align: justify">On February 27, 2020, the Secretariat
of Energy published in the Official Gazette Resolution No. 31 (&#8220;Resolution 31&#8221;) which sets forth the criteria to calculate
the economic transactions of energy and power that the generating parties commercialize in the spot market, which was in force as from
February 1, 2020.</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0 20.1pt 0 0; text-align: justify">&#160;</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0 20.1pt 0 8.35pt; text-align: justify">This new regulation, contrary to Resolution
1, establishes all prices for the remuneration of energy and power in Argentine pesos, and it sets forth that the prices would be adjusted
on a monthly basis with a formula based on the evolution of Consumer Price Index (IPC) and the Domestic Wholesale Price Index (IPIM).
New power prices were generally reduced in relation to the current prices as of January 2020, and the energy prices remained equivalent,
expressed in Argentine pesos instead of US dollars. Finally, this regulation introduced a new remuneration component which applied to
the energy generated during the first 50 hours of maximum thermal requirement of the month (MTR, which is determined by the sum of the
hours of all the thermal generation of the system), it determines different remuneration prices based on the season of the year and the
energy delivered during the first and second 25 hours of MTR.</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0.1pt 0 0; text-align: left">&#160;</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0.05pt 20.1pt 0 8.35pt; text-align: justify">On April 8, 2020, the Company
learned that the Secretariat of Energy instructed CAMMESA to postpone until further notice the application of the price update mechanism
described in the second paragraph of this note. Accordingly, CAMMESA did not apply the price update mechanism to the energy and power
sold since March 2020.</p>

<ix:exclude><p id="xdx_23F_zL1bjfQZrqik" style="font: bold 12pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 4.1pt 16.05pt 0 4.25pt; text-align: center">CENTRAL PUERTO S.A.</p></ix:exclude>

<p style="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0 20.25pt 0 0; text-align: justify">&#160;</p>

<ix:exclude><p id="xdx_234_zpBi0dMgZ4W5" style="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0 20.25pt 0 0; text-align: justify">&#160;</p></ix:exclude>

<table cellpadding="0" cellspacing="0" style="font: bold 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; width: 100%; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0"><tr style="vertical-align: top">
<td style="width: 8.35pt"/><td style="width: 13.6pt">g)</td><td style="text-align: left">Secretariat of Energy Resolution No. 440/2021</td></tr></table>

<p style="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0 20.15pt 0 0; text-align: justify">&#160;</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0 20.15pt 0 8.35pt; text-align: justify">Through Resolution No. 440 (&#8220;Resolution
440&#8221;), published in the Official Gazette on May 21, 2021, the Secretariat of Energy established a new remuneration scheme for MEM
generation agents. In this regard, Exhibits II, III, IV and V of Resolution 31 were replaced. Moreover, section 2 of Resolution 31, which
established a system for the automatic updating of remuneration values, was repealed. In general terms, Resolution 440 increased the remuneration
values of generation agents by 29% compared to Resolution 31.</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0; text-align: left">&#160;</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0 20.15pt 0 8.35pt; text-align: justify">It was established that for what Resolution
440 set forth (collection of the new values as from February 2021 transactions, among others), MEM generation agents must submit before
CAMMESA a note -to CAMMESA&#8217;s satisfaction- stating full and unconditional withdrawal of any administrative complaint or ongoing
judicial procedure against the National Government, the Secretariat of Energy and/or CAMMESA, related to section 2 of Resolution 31. Dated
June 17, 2021, the Company submitted the requested withdrawal note.</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0; text-align: left">&#160;</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0.05pt 20.2pt 0 8.35pt; text-align: justify">In addition, on November 9, 2021,
the Secretariat of Energy established that in order to determine the Power Availability Remuneration of thermal generators under Resolution
440, a constant Utilization Factor equal to 70% must be considered.</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0.05pt 0 0; text-align: left">&#160;</p>

<table cellpadding="0" cellspacing="0" style="font: bold 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; width: 100%; margin-top: 0.05pt; margin-bottom: 0"><tr style="vertical-align: top">
<td style="width: 8.35pt"/><td style="width: 13.6pt">h)</td><td style="text-align: left">Secretariat of Energy Resolution No. 354/2020</td></tr></table>

<p style="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0 20.1pt 0 0; text-align: justify">&#160;</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0 20.1pt 0 8.3pt; text-align: justify">This resolution established, among other
things, that as from the effectiveness of Plan &#8220;GasAr&#8221; (Plan Gas 4), Generators of WEM may adhere to centralized dispatch,
assigning CAMMESA such contracts entered into with producers or transporters of natural gas, so that such contracts are used by the Dispatch
Entity (OED for its acronym in Spanish), based on dispatch criteria.</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0; text-align: left">&#160;</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0 20.1pt 0 8.3pt; text-align: justify">In addition, this resolution established
that generation agents who, pursuant to Resolution No. 287/2017, have the obligation of self-procuring fuel are able to deem such obligations
null and therefore, have their associated costs recognized, and they must keep maintenance of the transport capacity for its management
in centralized dispatch, as long as CAMMESA determines the convenience of having such.</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0.15pt 0 0; text-align: left">&#160;</p>

<table cellpadding="0" cellspacing="0" style="font: bold 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; width: 100%; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0"><tr style="vertical-align: top">
<td style="width: 8.3pt"/><td style="width: 13.6pt">i)</td><td style="text-align: left">Secretariat of Energy Resolution No. 238/2022</td></tr></table>

<p style="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0 20.1pt 0 0; text-align: justify">&#160;</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0 20.1pt 0 8.3pt; text-align: justify">On April 21, 2022, Resolution No. 238/2022
("Resolution 238") issued by the Secretariat of Energy was published in the Official Gazette. This resolution updates remuneration
prices for energy and capacity of generation units not committed on a Purchase Power Agreement, it replaces Annex I to V of the former
Resolution No. 440/2021 and it abolishes section 4 of Resolution No. 1037/2021, which granted an additional and temporary increase to
generators remuneration. It also removes the Use Factor from the capacity payment calculation, improving revenue performance.</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0.05pt 0 0; text-align: left">&#160;</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0 20.1pt 0 8.3pt; text-align: justify">Resolution 238 increased by 30% the
remuneration values starting February 2022, and it provided an additional 10% above the new values starting in June 2022.</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0 20.1pt 0 0; text-align: justify">&#160;</p>

<table cellpadding="0" cellspacing="0" style="font: bold 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; width: 100%; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0"><tr style="vertical-align: top">
<td style="width: 8.65pt"/><td style="width: 13.7pt">j)</td><td style="text-align: left">Secretariat of Energy Resolution No. 826/2022</td></tr></table>

<p style="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0; text-align: left"><b>&#160;</b></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0 20.1pt 0 8.3pt; text-align: justify">On December 14, 2022, Resolution No.
826/2022 (&#8220;Resolution 826&#8221;) issued by the Secretariat of Energy was published in the Official Gazette, through which the power
and energy remuneration values of the generation not committed under contracts were updated. Exhibits I to V of Resolution No. 238 were
replaced therein, and a 20% retroactive increase was ordered as of September 1, 2022, as well as the following consecutive increases:
10% as from December 1, 2022, 25% as from February 1, 2023 and 28% as from August 1, 2023.</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0.05pt 0 0; text-align: left">&#160;</p>

<table cellpadding="0" cellspacing="0" style="font: bold 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; width: 100%; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0"><tr style="vertical-align: top">
<td style="width: 8.3pt"/><td style="width: 13.6pt">k)</td><td style="text-align: left">Secretariat of Energy Resolution No. 59/2023</td></tr></table>

<p style="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0.05pt 0 0; text-align: left"><b>&#160;</b></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0 20.25pt 0 8.3pt; text-align: justify">On February 7, 2023, Resolution No.
59/2023 (&#8220;Resolution 59&#8221;) was published in the Official Gazette whereby generators with combined cycle units are authorized
to adhere to the Power Availability and Efficiency Improvement Agreement (the "Agreement") so as to foster the necessary investments
for major and minor maintenance of the equipment.</p>

<ix:exclude><p id="xdx_234_zGxC034kdav1" style="font: bold 12pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 4.1pt 16.05pt 0 4.25pt; text-align: center">CENTRAL PUERTO S.A.</p></ix:exclude>

<p style="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0 20.25pt 0 0; text-align: justify">&#160;</p>

<ix:exclude><p id="xdx_238_zraX7LVhoiEb" style="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0 20.25pt 0 0; text-align: justify">&#160;</p></ix:exclude>

<p style="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0 20pt 0 8.35pt; text-align: justify">Through this agreement, adhering generators
commit to reach, at least, 85% of monthly average power availability in exchange of a new power and energy price formed, in part, by amounts
denominated in US dollars. In the case of power, a 2,000 USD/MW-month, plus the amount in ARS corresponding to the 85% and 65% of the
power value established by Resolution 826 is set for the spring/autumn and summer/winter periods, respectively. Additionally, the price
for generated energy is set at 3.5 USD/MWh in case of using gas, and at 6.1 USD/MWh in case of alternative fuel (gasoil) use.</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0.05pt 0 0; text-align: left">&#160;</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0 20pt 0 8.35pt; text-align: justify">On April 25, 2023, CAMMESA accepted the
subscription to the Agreement of all the Group's combined cycle units, except for the unit so-called Buenos Aires that belongs to Central
Costanera S.A. Hence, an increase in the remuneration of these units for their sales to the spot market occurred from the transactions
since March 2023, as described in the preceding paragraph.</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0; text-align: left">&#160;</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0 20pt 0 8.35pt; text-align: justify">Regarding Buenos Aires combined cycle,
on July 28, 2023 CAMMESA agreed to the Agreement subscription by Central Costanera S.A. (valid as from July transactions), once the Secretariat
of Energy successfully ordered CAMMESA the following regarding the mentioned thermal unit: a) conversion to mono-fuel, i.e. operation
just with natural gas, eliminating the possibility of operation with gas oil; and b) the adequation of the installed capacity to the real
technical possibility of energy generation by the combined cycle. During the month of October 2023, the corrective maintenance tasks of
this unit were concluded, therefore, the increases in the remuneration of this unit were applied as from the transactions of October 2023.</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0 20pt 0 0; text-align: justify">&#160;</p>

<table cellpadding="0" cellspacing="0" style="font: bold 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; width: 100%; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0"><tr style="vertical-align: top">
<td style="width: 8.65pt"/><td style="width: 13.7pt">l)</td><td style="text-align: left; padding-right: 20.15pt">Secretariat of Energy Resolution No. 574/2023, 2/2024, 33/2024 and 78/2024. PEN Decree
No. 718/2024</td></tr></table>

<p style="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0.1pt 0 0; text-align: left"><b>&#160;</b></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0 20.1pt 0 8.35pt; text-align: justify">On July 11, 2023, Resolution No. 574/2023
was published, which extended for 60 days (with the possibility of being extended for 60 days more) the termination date for the Concession
Agreement of the Hydroelectric Power Station Piedra del &#193;guila, among other Argentine Hydroelectric Power Stations, whose concession
term was set to end during 2023.</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0; text-align: left">&#160;</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0 20.05pt 0 8.35pt; text-align: justify">On January 17, 2024, through Resolution
No. 2/2024, published in the Official Gazette, the transition period of the concession agreement was extended for 60 days starting February
28, 2024. Then, through Resolution No. 33/2024, published in the Official Gazette on March 18, 2024, the termination term of the concession
agreement was extended again for 60 days starting April 28, 2024, so that term expires on June 27, 2024.</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0; text-align: left">&#160;</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0 20.2pt 0 8.35pt; text-align: justify">On May 17, 2024, through Resolution
No. 78/2024, the transition period of the concession contract was extended until the end of the term established in the contract, that
is, December 28, 2024.</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0 20.2pt 0 0; text-align: justify">&#160;</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0 20.05pt 0 8.35pt; text-align: justify">On August 12, 2024, PEN Decree No.
718/2024 was published in the Official Gazette, which extended for one year the term to continue operating the Piedra del &#193;guila
Hydroelectric Complex by CPSA in its capacity as concessionaire, with a maximum date of December 28, 2025. The mentioned Decree also establishes
that, within one hundred and eighty days of its publication, the Secretariat of Energy will call for a National and International Public
Tender in order to proceed with the sale of the stock package of the companies created for each of the hydroelectric power stations of
Comahue.</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0.05pt 0 0; text-align: left">&#160;</p>

<table cellpadding="0" cellspacing="0" style="font: bold 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; width: 100%; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0"><tr style="vertical-align: top">
<td style="width: 8.65pt"/><td style="width: 13.7pt">m)</td><td style="text-align: left">Secretariat of Energy Resolution No. 750/2023</td></tr></table>

<p style="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0.05pt 0 0; text-align: left"><b>&#160;</b></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0 20.15pt 0 8.35pt; text-align: justify">On September 6, 2023, Secretariat
of Energy Resolution No. 750/2023 (&#8220;Resolution 750&#8221;) was published in the Official Gazette. Resolution 750 updated the amounts
of remuneration for power and energy for the generation which is not committed in contracts. Thus, Annexes I to IV of Resolution 826 were
replaced and a 23% increase as from September 1, 2023 was established.</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0; text-align: left">&#160;</p>

<table cellpadding="0" cellspacing="0" style="font: bold 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; width: 100%; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0"><tr style="vertical-align: top">
<td style="width: 8.65pt"/><td style="width: 13.7pt">n)</td><td style="text-align: left">Secretariat of Energy Resolution No. 869/2023</td></tr></table>

<p style="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0.05pt 0 0; text-align: left"><b>&#160;</b></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0 20.1pt 0 8.35pt; text-align: justify">On October 30, 2023, Secretariat of
Energy Resolution No. 869/2023 (&#8220;Resolution 869&#8221;) was published in the Official Gazette. Resolution 869 updated the amounts
of remuneration for power and energy of the generation which is not committed in contracts. Thus, Annexes I to IV of Resolution 750 were
replaced and a 28% increase as from November 1, 2023 was established.</p>

No. 9/2024 (&#8220;Resolution 9&#8221;) of the Secretariat of Energy was published in the Official Gazette. This Resolution updated the
power and energy remuneration values of the generation not committed under contracts. In addition, Exhibits I to IV of Resolution No.
869 were replaced and a 74% increase effective as from February 1, 2024 was established.</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0.05pt 20.05pt 0 8.4pt; text-align: justify">&#160;</p>

of the generation not committed under contracts were updated. This resolution replaces Exhibits I to V of Resolution No. 9/2024 and establishes
a 25% increase effective as from June 1, 2024.</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0.05pt 20.05pt 0 8.4pt; text-align: justify">&#160;</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0.05pt 20.05pt 0 8.4pt; text-align: justify">On August 2, 2024, Resolution
No. 193/2024 issued by the Secretariat of Energy was published in the Official Gazette, through which the power and energy remuneration
values of the generation not committed under contracts were updated. This resolution replaces Exhibits I to V of Resolution No. 99/2024
and establishes a 3% increase effective as from August 1, 2024.</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0.05pt 20.05pt 0 0; text-align: justify">&#160;</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0.05pt 20.05pt 0 8.4pt; text-align: justify">On August 30, 2024, Resolution
No. 233/2024 issued by the Secretariat of Energy was published in the Official Gazette, through which the power and energy remuneration
values of the generation not committed under contracts were updated. This resolution replaces Exhibits I to V of Resolution No. 193/2024
and establishes a 5% increase effective as from September 1, 2024.</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0.05pt 20.05pt 0 8.4pt; text-align: justify">&#160;</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0.05pt 20.05pt 0 8.4pt; text-align: justify">On September 30, 2024, Resolution
No. 285/2024 issued by the Secretariat of Energy was published in the Official Gazette, through which the power and energy remuneration
values of the generation not committed under contracts were updated. This resolution replaces Exhibits I to V of Resolution No. 233/2024
and establishes a 2,7% increase effective as from October 1, 2024.</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0.05pt 20.05pt 0 8.4pt; text-align: justify">&#160;</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0.05pt 20.05pt 0 8.4pt; text-align: justify">On November 1, 2024, Resolution
No. 20/2024 issued by the Secretariat for Coordination of Energy and Mining was published in the Official Gazette, through which the power
and energy remuneration values of the generation not committed under contracts were updated. This resolution replaces Exhibits I to V
of Resolution No. 285/2024 and establishes a 6% increase effective as from November 1, 2024.</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0.05pt 20.05pt 0 8.4pt; text-align: justify">&#160;</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0.05pt 20.05pt 0 8.4pt; text-align: justify">On December 2, 2024, Resolution

values of the generation not committed under contracts were updated. This resolution replaces Exhibits I to V of Resolution No. 20/2024
and establishes a 5% increase effective as from December 1, 2024.</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0.05pt 20.05pt 0 8.4pt; text-align: justify">&#160;</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0.05pt 20.05pt 0 8.4pt; text-align: justify">On December 27, 2024, Resolution
No. 603/2024 issued by the Secretariat of Energy was published in the Official Gazette, through which the power and energy remuneration
values of the generation not committed under contracts were updated. This resolution replaces Exhibits I to V of Resolution No. 387/2024
and establishes a 4% increase effective as from January 1, 2025.</p>

and Forecast Plan for critical months of the 2024/2026 period", defining measures that cover the supply of generation, transportation
and distribution of energy.</p>

the MEM or that have not adhered to S.E. Resolution No. 59/2023.</p>

with the steam turbine (ST) units located in Buenos Aires and Luj&#225;n de Cuyo and the gas turbine (GT) units located in Luj&#225;n

<p style="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0 20.1pt 0 8.4pt; text-align: justify">On May 8, 2024, Secretariat of Energy
Resolution No. 58/2024 as amended by Resolution No. 66/2024 was published in the Official Gazette (the &#8220;Resolution&#8221;) whereby
an exceptional, temporary, and unique payment regime was established for MEM transactions for December 2023, and January and February
2024. Such Resolution (i) orders CAMMESA to prepare and determine the amounts of the credit for the economic transactions with each of
MEM Creditor Agents in a term of 5 (five) working days from the effective date of the Resolution; (ii) establishes that the lack of agreement
regarding such amounts authorizes the Creditor Agents to resort to the corresponding judicial, administrative and/or out-of-court means;
(iii) stipulates that once the amounts are determined and the corresponding agreements are signed, CAMMESA shall pay the transactions
as follows: a) the settlement for the transactions for December 2023 and January 2024 shall be paid 10 (ten) working days from the date
of individual agreements through the delivery of bond AE38 USD; the calculation of nominal amounts to be delivered per each bond shall
be at the reference exchange rate (Communication &#8220;A&#8221; 3500) at the quote in force at closing on the date of the formal acceptance
by Creditor Agents; b) settlement for February 2024 shall be paid with available funds in bank accounts authorized in CAMMESA for collection
and with the available funds from the transfers made by the Argentine State to the Unified Fund allocated to the Stabilization Fund. The
Group&#180;s MEM economic transactions for December 2023 and January and February 2024 amount to <span id="xdx_909_ecustom--EconomicTransactions_iI_pn3n3_c20231231_zqmIMv8FINMg" title="Economic transactions"><ix:nonFraction name="CEPU:EconomicTransactions" contextRef="AsOf2023-12-31" id="Fact001104" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="-3" scale="3" unitRef="ARS">30,681,066</ix:nonFraction></span>, <span id="xdx_90C_ecustom--EconomicTransactions_iI_pn3n3_c20240131_zJoLsXxjE0Me" title="Economic transactions"><ix:nonFraction name="CEPU:EconomicTransactions" contextRef="AsOf2024-01-31" id="Fact001106" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="-3" scale="3" unitRef="ARS">30,930,604</ix:nonFraction></span> and <span id="xdx_904_ecustom--EconomicTransactions_iI_pn3n3_c20240229_zjGNYtbMxaca" title="Economic transactions"><ix:nonFraction name="CEPU:EconomicTransactions" contextRef="AsOf2024-02-29" id="Fact001108" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="-3" scale="3" unitRef="ARS">40,511,360</ix:nonFraction></span>
(VAT included), respectively, measured at nominal values of each dates.</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0.1pt 0 0; text-align: left">&#160;</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0 20.1pt 0 8.4pt; text-align: justify">On May 23, 2024, the Group entered into
agreements with CAMMESA under the provisions of the Resolution. As a result of these agreements, the Group recognized a loss of <span id="xdx_905_ecustom--AgreementWithCAMMESAResolutionsSENo582024And662024_iI_pn3n3_c20240523_z6zZfv9evAc4" title="Agreement with CAMMESA - Resolutions SE No 58/2024 and 66/2024"><ix:nonFraction name="CEPU:AgreementWithCAMMESAResolutionsSENo582024And662024" contextRef="AsOf2024-05-23" id="Fact001110" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="-3" scale="3" unitRef="ARS">24,783,504</ix:nonFraction></span>,
which is reported under the line "Agreement with Cammesa - SE Resolutions No. 58/2024 and 66/2024" within the "Other operating
expenses" section of the consolidated statement of income. During May and June 2024, the exchange of the AE38 USD bond for the MEM
economic transactions of December 2023 and January 2024 was completed, and the MEM economic transaction for February 2024 was fully collected.</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0 20.1pt 0 8.4pt; text-align: justify">On January 28, 2025, Secretariat of
Energy Resolution No. 21/2025 was published in the Official Gazette, establishing that new conventional electric power generation projects,
commercially enabled as of January 1, 2025, may enter into supply contracts in the Term Market with Large Users and Distributors. Additionally,
Resolution No. 354/2020 issued by the Secretariat of Energy was repealed, modifying some considerations of the GasAr Plan and the priorities
for natural gas consumption in the Electric Market. It was also established that as of March 1, 2025, generators selling their energy
in the spot market may purchase their fuel, and it will be recognized by CAMMESA according to the variable production cost declared and
recognized by the generator. The cost of unsupplied energy in the MEM was also set, with a maximum value of 1500 USD/MWh when it exceeds
10% of the system's demand. Finally, the Energ&#237;a Plus scheme was repealed, with existing contracts remaining in force until their
termination.</p>

<ix:nonNumeric contextRef="From2024-01-01to2024-12-31" escape="true" id="Fact001116" name="CEPU:BasisOfPreparationPolicyTextBlock"><p id="xdx_84E_ecustom--BasisOfPreparationPolicyTextBlock_zAzv4BQhKoEk" style="font: bold 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0; text-align: left">&#160;</p>

<td style="width: 8.65pt"/><td style="width: 27.35pt">2.1.</td><td style="text-align: left"><span id="xdx_86E_zNWrsXP1Sebg">Basis of preparation</span></td></tr></table>

<p style="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0.05pt 0 0; text-align: left"><b>&#160;</b></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0 20.2pt 0 8.35pt; text-align: justify">The consolidated financial statements
of the Group have been prepared in accordance with IFRS Accounting Standards as issued by the International Accounting Standards Board
(IASB).</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0 0 0 8.35pt; text-align: justify">&#160;</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0 20.2pt 0 8.35pt; text-align: justify">The attached financial statements have
been prepared in order to be included in a Securities and Exchange Commission (&#8220;SEC&#8221;) filing and have been approved by the
Company&#8217;s Board of Directors on April, 25, 2025.</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0.05pt 0 0; text-align: left">&#160;</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0 20.2pt 0 8.35pt; text-align: justify">These consolidated financial statements
provide comparative information in respect of the previous years.</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0.05pt 0 0; text-align: left">&#160;</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0 20.2pt 0 8.35pt; text-align: justify">In preparing these consolidated financial
statements, the Group applied the material accounting policies, estimates and assumptions described in Notes 2.2 and 2.3, respectively.
Moreover, the Group has adopted the changes in accounting policies described in Note 2.4.</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0; text-align: left">&#160;</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0 20.2pt 0 8.35pt; text-align: justify">The Group&#8217;s consolidated financial
statements are presented in Argentine pesos, which is the Group&#8217;s functional currency, and all values have been rounded to the nearest
thousand (ARS 000), except when otherwise indicated.</p>

</ix:nonNumeric><ix:nonNumeric contextRef="From2024-01-01to2024-12-31" escape="true" id="Fact001118" name="ifrs-full:DisclosureOfBasisOfConsolidationExplanatory"><p id="xdx_84B_eifrs-full--DisclosureOfBasisOfConsolidationExplanatory_zsssp9JEfFZ" style="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0 20.2pt 0 0; text-align: justify">&#160;</p>

<table cellpadding="0" cellspacing="0" style="font: bold 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; width: 100%; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0"><tr style="vertical-align: top">
<td style="width: 8.4pt"/><td style="width: 36pt">2.1.1.</td><td style="text-align: left"><span id="xdx_863_zImKX4uSnuO8">Basis of consolidation</span></td></tr></table>

<p style="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0.05pt 0 0; text-align: left"><b>&#160;</b></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0 20.05pt 0 8.35pt; text-align: justify">The consolidated financial statements
as of December 31, 2024 and 2023 and for each of the years ended December 31, 2024, 2023 and 2022, include the financial statements of
the Group formed by the parent company and its subsidiaries: Central Vuelta de Obligado S.A., Proener S.A.U., and its controlled companies,
Vientos La Genoveva S.A.U., Vientos La Genoveva II S.A.U. and CP Renovables S.A. and its subsidiaries.</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0; text-align: left">&#160;</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0 20.05pt 0 8.35pt; text-align: justify">Control is achieved when the investor
is exposed or entitled to variable returns arising from its ownership interest in the investee, and has the ability to affect such returns
through its power over the investee. Specifically, the investor controls an investee, if and only if it has:</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0 20.05pt 0 8.35pt; text-align: justify">&#160;</p>

<table cellpadding="0" cellspacing="0" style="font: 11pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; width: 100%; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0"><tr style="vertical-align: top">
<td style="width: 8.4pt"/><td style="width: 18pt"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#8211;</span></td><td style="text-align: left; padding-right: 20.2pt"><span style="font-size: 10pt">Power over the investee (i.e. the investor has rights
that entitle it to direct the relevant activities of the investee).</span></td></tr></table>

<p style="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0; text-align: left">&#160;</p>

<table cellpadding="0" cellspacing="0" style="font: 11pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; width: 100%; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0"><tr style="vertical-align: top">
<td style="width: 8.4pt"/><td style="width: 17.95pt"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#8211;</span></td><td style="text-align: left"><span style="font-size: 10pt">Exposure or right to variable returns arising from its ownership interest in
the investee.</span></td></tr></table>

<p style="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0 0 0 26.35pt; text-align: left; text-indent: 0in">&#160;</p>

<table cellpadding="0" cellspacing="0" style="font: 11pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; width: 100%; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0"><tr style="vertical-align: top">
<td style="width: 8.4pt"/><td style="width: 17.95pt"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#8211;</span></td><td style="text-align: left"><span style="font-size: 10pt">Ability to exercise its power over the investee to significantly affect its
returns.</span></td></tr></table>

<p style="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0; text-align: left">&#160;</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0 20.15pt 0 8.65pt; text-align: justify">Consolidation of a subsidiary begins
when the parent company obtains control over the subsidiary and ends when the parent company loses control over the subsidiary. The assets,
liabilities, income and expenses of a subsidiary acquired or sold during the fiscal year are included in the consolidated financial statements
from the date on which the parent company acquired control of the subsidiary to the date on which the parent company ceased to control
the subsidiary.</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0; text-align: left">&#160;</p>

<ix:exclude><!-- Field: Page; Sequence: 322 -->
    <div id="xdx_234_zVO3OU4JnLz1" style="border-bottom: Black 1pt solid; margin-bottom: 6pt"><p style="margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0">&#160;</p><table cellpadding="0" cellspacing="0" style="width: 100%"><tr><td style="text-align: center; width: 100%"><span style="font-size: 10pt">F-<!-- Field: Sequence; Type: Arabic; Name: PageNo -->20<!-- Field: /Sequence -->&#160;</span></td></tr></table></div>
    <div id="xdx_239_zrOvGZfSIpf" style="break-before: page; margin-top: 6pt"><table cellpadding="0" cellspacing="0" style="font: 12pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; border-collapse: collapse; width: 100%"><tr style="vertical-align: top; text-align: left"><td style="width: 100%"><span style="font-size: 10pt"><a href="#TableOfContents" style="font-style: italic">Table of Contents</a></span></td></tr><tr style="vertical-align: top; text-align: left"><td>&#160;</td></tr></table></div>
    <!-- Field: /Page --></ix:exclude>

<ix:exclude><p id="xdx_232_zhmXe0GIlkBg" style="font: bold 12pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 4.1pt 16.05pt 0 4.25pt; text-align: center">CENTRAL PUERTO S.A.</p></ix:exclude>

<ix:exclude><p id="xdx_23B_zlEVKPwDC5A1" style="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0 20.25pt 0 0; text-align: justify">&#160;</p></ix:exclude>

<ix:exclude><p id="xdx_231_zXJXF7LdQzT4" style="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0 20.25pt 0 0; text-align: justify">&#160;</p></ix:exclude>

<p style="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0 20.05pt 0 8.35pt; text-align: justify"></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0 20.05pt 0 8.35pt; text-align: justify">The result for the fiscal year and
each component of the other comprehensive income (loss) are assigned to the owners of the parent company and non-controlling interests,
even if the results of the non-controlling interests give rise to a debit balance. If necessary, appropriate adjustments are made to
the subsidiaries&#8217; financial statements so that their accounting policies are in accordance with the Group&#8217;s accounting policies.
All assets and liabilities, equity, income, expenses and cash flows within the Group that relate to transactions among the members of
the Group are completely eliminated in the consolidation process.</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0; text-align: left">&#160;</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0 20.1pt 0 8.35pt; text-align: justify">A change in ownership interest in a
subsidiary, without loss of control, is accounted for as an equity transaction. If the Group loses control of a subsidiary, it cancels
the carrying amount of the assets (including goodwill) and related liabilities, non-controlling interests and other equity components,
while recognizing the profit or loss resulting from the transaction in the relevant income statement.</p>

</ix:nonNumeric><ix:nonNumeric contextRef="From2024-01-01to2024-12-31" escape="true" id="Fact001123" name="CEPU:DescriptionOfAccountingPolicyForMeasuringUnitExplanatory"><p id="xdx_84A_ecustom--DescriptionOfAccountingPolicyForMeasuringUnitExplanatory_zppFmNtqR57d" style="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0; text-align: left">&#160;</p>

<table cellpadding="0" cellspacing="0" style="font: bold 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; width: 100%; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0"><tr style="vertical-align: top">
<td style="width: 8.4pt"/><td style="width: 36pt">2.1.2.</td><td style="text-align: left"><span id="xdx_864_zStKIBlrIeG9">Measuring unit</span></td></tr></table>

<p style="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0.05pt 0 0; text-align: left"><b>&#160;</b></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0 19.95pt 0 8.35pt; text-align: justify">The financial statements as at December
31, 2024, including the figures for the previous periods (this fact not affecting the decisions taken on the financial information for
such periods) were restated to consider the changes in the general purchasing power of the functional currency of the Company (Argentine
peso) pursuant to IAS 29. Consequently, the financial statements are stated in the current measurement unit at the end of the reported
period.</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0; text-align: left">&#160;</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0 20.05pt 0 8.35pt; text-align: justify">In accordance with IAS 29, the restatement
of the financial statements is necessary when the functional currency of an entity is the currency of a hyperinflationary economy. To
define a hyperinflationary state, the IAS 29 provides a series of non-exclusive guidelines that consist on (i) analyzing the behavior
of the population, prices, interest rates and wages before the evolution of price indexes and the loss of the currency&#8217;s purchasing
power, and (ii) as a quantitative characteristic, which is the most considered condition in practice, verifying if the three-year cumulative
inflation rate approaches or exceeds 100%.</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0 20.05pt 0 8.35pt; text-align: justify">&#160;</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0 20.1pt 0 8.35pt; text-align: justify">Due to different macroeconomic factors,
the triennial inflation in 2024 was higher than such figure, as the goals of the Argentine government, and other available projections,
indicate that this trend will not revert in the short term.</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0; text-align: left">&#160;</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0 20.15pt 0 8.35pt; text-align: justify">So as to evaluate the mentioned quantitative
condition and to restate the financial statements, the Argentine Securities Commission established that the series of indexes to be used
in the IAS 29 application is the one established by the Argentine Federation of Professional Councils in Economic Sciences.</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0; text-align: left">&#160;</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0 20.05pt 0 8.35pt; text-align: justify">Considering the before mentioned index,
the inflation was 117.76%, 211.41% and 94.79% for the years ended December 31, 2024, 2023 and 2022, respectively.</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0 20.05pt 0 8.35pt; text-align: justify">&#160;</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0 0 0 8.35pt; text-align: justify">The following is a summary of the effects
of the IAS 29 application:</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0; text-align: left">&#160;</p>

<p style="font: bold 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0 0 0 8.35pt; text-align: justify">Restatement of the Balance Sheet</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0; text-align: left"><b>&#160;</b></p>

<table cellpadding="0" cellspacing="0" style="font: 11pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; width: 100%; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0"><tr style="vertical-align: top">
<td style="width: 8.8pt"/><td style="width: 18.05pt"><span style="font-size: 10pt; letter-spacing: -0.05pt">(i)</span></td><td style="text-align: justify; padding-right: 20.05pt"><span style="font-size: 10pt">The monetary items (those with a fixed face value
in local currency) are not restated since they are stated in the current measurement unit at the closing date of the reported period.
In an inflationary period, keeping monetary assets causes the loss of purchasing power, and keeping monetary liabilities causes gain in
purchasing power as long as those items are not tied to an adjustment mechanism compensating those effects. The monetary loss or gain
is included in the income (loss) for the reported period.</span></td></tr></table>

<p style="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0; text-align: left">&#160;</p>

<table cellpadding="0" cellspacing="0" style="font: 11pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; width: 100%; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0"><tr style="vertical-align: top">
<td style="width: 8.85pt"/><td style="width: 18pt"><span style="font-size: 10pt; letter-spacing: -0.05pt">(ii)</span></td><td style="text-align: justify; padding-right: 20.2pt"><span style="font-size: 10pt">The assets and liabilities subject to changes established
in specific agreements are adjusted in accordance with those agreements.</span></td></tr></table>

<p style="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0 20.1pt 0 0; text-align: justify">&#160;</p>

<table cellpadding="0" cellspacing="0" style="font: 11pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; width: 100%; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0"><tr style="vertical-align: top">
<td style="width: 8.35pt"/><td style="width: 18pt"><span style="font-size: 10pt; letter-spacing: -0.05pt">(iii)</span></td><td style="text-align: justify; padding-right: 20.1pt"><span style="font-size: 10pt">Non-monetary items measured at their fair values
at the end of the reported period are not restated to be included in the balance sheet; however, the adjustment process must be completed
to determine the income (loss) produced for having those non-monetary items in the terms of a uniform measurement unit.</span></td></tr></table>

<p style="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0; text-align: left">&#160;</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0 20.1pt 0 26.35pt; text-align: justify">As at December 31, 2024 and 2023,
the Company counted with the following items measured with the current value method: biological assets and the share kept in foreign currency
of the items Trade and other receivables, Cash and cash equivalents, Other financial assets, Loans and borrowings and Trade and other
payables.</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0 20.1pt 0 26.35pt; text-align: justify">&#160;</p>

<ix:exclude><p id="xdx_231_zVFScJTH5P21" style="font: bold 12pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 4.1pt 16.05pt 0 4.25pt; text-align: center">CENTRAL PUERTO S.A.</p></ix:exclude>

<ix:exclude><p id="xdx_231_zswUq1l2PwJ6" style="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0 20.25pt 0 0; text-align: justify">&#160;</p></ix:exclude>

<ix:exclude><p id="xdx_239_z12AmFrdkmTd" style="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0 20.25pt 0 0; text-align: justify">&#160;</p></ix:exclude>

<table cellpadding="0" cellspacing="0" style="font: 11pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; width: 100%; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0"><tr style="vertical-align: top">
<td style="width: 8.35pt"/><td style="width: 18.05pt"><span style="font-size: 10pt; letter-spacing: -0.05pt">(iv)</span></td><td style="text-align: justify; padding-right: 20.05pt"><span style="font-size: 10pt">Non-monetary items at historical cost or at fair
value of a date previous to the end of the reported period are restated at rates reflecting the variation occurred at the general level
of prices from the acquisition or revaluation date until the end of the reported period; then the amounts restated for those assets are
compared with the corresponding recoverable values. Charges to the income (loss) for the period due to property, plant and equipment depreciation
and intangible assets amortization, as well as other non- monetary assets consumption are determined in accordance with the new restated
amounts.</span></td></tr></table>

<p style="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0.05pt 0 0; text-align: left">&#160;</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0 0 0 26.4pt; text-align: left">As at December 31, 2024 and 2023, the items
subject to this restatement process were the following:</p>

<table cellpadding="0" cellspacing="0" style="font: 11pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; width: 100%; margin-top: 11.4pt; margin-bottom: 0"><tr style="vertical-align: top">
<td style="width: 8.35pt"/><td style="width: 18pt"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#8211;</span></td><td style="text-align: justify; padding-right: 20.1pt"><span style="font-size: 10pt">Non-monetary items measured at fair value of a date
previous to the end of the reported period: certain machines, equipment, turbogroups and auxiliary equipment of the Property, Plant and
Equipment item, which were measured at their fair value as at January 1, 2011 (transition date to IFRS Accounting Standards as issued
by the International Accounting Standards Board (IASB)) and Property, Plant and Equipment items acquired in business combinations which
were measured at fair value at acquisition date.</span></td></tr></table>

<table cellpadding="0" cellspacing="0" style="font: 11pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; width: 100%; margin-top: 11.45pt; margin-bottom: 0"><tr style="vertical-align: top">
<td style="width: 8.35pt"/><td style="width: 18.05pt"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#8211;</span></td><td style="text-align: justify; padding-right: 20.2pt"><span style="font-size: 10pt">Non-monetary items at historical cost: the remaining
items of Property, Plant and Equipment, Intangible assets, Investment in associates, Inventories and Deferred income tax liabilities and
assets.</span></td></tr></table>

<p style="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0; text-align: left">&#160;</p>

<table cellpadding="0" cellspacing="0" style="font: 11pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; width: 100%; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0"><tr style="vertical-align: top">
<td style="width: 8.35pt"/><td style="width: 18.05pt"><span style="font-size: 10pt; letter-spacing: -0.05pt">(v)</span></td><td style="text-align: justify; padding-right: 20.2pt"><span style="font-size: 10pt">When borrowing costs in non-monetary assets are capitalized
in accordance with IAS 23, the share of those cost compensating the creditor for the effects of inflation is not capitalized.</span></td></tr></table>

<p style="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0 0 0 26.4pt; text-align: left">The Company proceeded to the capitalization
of borrowing costs as stated in Note 2.2.6.</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0; text-align: left">&#160;</p>

<table cellpadding="0" cellspacing="0" style="font: 11pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; width: 100%; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0"><tr style="vertical-align: top">
<td style="width: 8.4pt"/><td style="width: 18pt"><span style="font-size: 10pt; letter-spacing: -0.05pt">(vi)</span></td><td style="text-align: justify; padding-right: 20.1pt"><span style="font-size: 10pt">The restatement of the non-monetary assets in the
terms of a current measurement unit at the end of the reported period without an equivalent adjustment for tax purposes leads to a temporary
taxable difference and to the recognition of a deferred-tax liability whose balancing entry is recognized in the income (loss) for the
period. In Note 8 the effects of this process are detailed.</span></td></tr></table>

<p style="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0; text-align: left">&#160;</p>

<p style="font: bold 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0 0 0 8.4pt; text-align: left">Restatement of the statement of income
(loss) and other comprehensive income</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0; text-align: left"><b>&#160;</b></p>

<table cellpadding="0" cellspacing="0" style="font: 11pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; width: 100%; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0"><tr style="vertical-align: top">
<td style="width: 8.35pt"/><td style="width: 18.05pt"><span style="font-size: 10pt; letter-spacing: -0.05pt">(i)</span></td><td style="text-align: justify; padding-right: 20pt"><span style="font-size: 10pt">The expenses and income are restated as from the date
of accountable entry, including interest and currency exchange differences, except for those items not reflecting or including in their
determination the consumption of assets measured in currency of purchasing power previous to the consumption entry, which are restated
taking into account the origin date of the asset related to the item (for example, depreciation, devaluation and other consumptions of
assets valued at historical cost); and except for income (loss) emerging from comparing two measurements expressed in currency of purchasing
power of different dates. For such purpose, it is necessary to identify the compared amounts, separately restate them and compare them
again, but with amounts already restated.</span></td></tr></table>

<p style="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0 20.1pt 0 26.4pt; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0in">&#160;</p>

<table cellpadding="0" cellspacing="0" style="font: 11pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; width: 100%; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0"><tr style="vertical-align: top">
<td style="width: 8.4pt"/><td style="width: 18pt"><span style="font-size: 10pt; letter-spacing: -0.05pt">(ii)</span></td><td style="text-align: justify; padding-right: 20.1pt"><span style="font-size: 10pt">The income (loss) for exposure to change in purchasing
power of currency (income (loss) on net monetary position), originated by the keeping of monetary assets and liabilities, is shown in
a separate item of the income (loss) for the period.</span></td></tr></table>

<p style="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0; text-align: left">&#160;</p>

<table cellpadding="0" cellspacing="0" style="font: 11pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; width: 100%; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0"><tr style="vertical-align: top">
<td style="width: 8.4pt"/><td style="width: 18pt"><span style="font-size: 10pt; letter-spacing: -0.05pt">(iii)</span></td><td style="text-align: justify; padding-right: 20.1pt"><span style="font-size: 10pt">Gains and losses on non-monetary items measured at
fair value are typically calculated as the difference between the restated opening balance, or if acquired during the year, the restated
acquisition date value, and the fair value on the reporting date.</span></td></tr></table>

<p style="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0; text-align: left">&#160;</p>

<p style="font: bold 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0 0 0 8.4pt; text-align: left">Restatement of the Statement of Changes
in Equity</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0 20pt 0 8.4pt; text-align: justify">&#160;</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0 20pt 0 8.4pt; text-align: justify">All the components of equity are restated
by applying the general prices index as from the beginning of the period, and each variation of such components is re-expressed as from
the contribution date or as from the moment in which such contribution was made through any other form, with the exception of the account
&#8220;Capital stock -face value&#8221; which has been maintained for its nominal value and the effects of their restatement can be found
in the account &#8220;Adjustment to capital stock&#8221;.</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0 20pt 0 8.4pt; text-align: justify">&#160;</p>

<ix:exclude><p id="xdx_238_zHNxEaWgS7yg" style="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0 20.25pt 0 0; text-align: justify">&#160;</p></ix:exclude>

<p style="font: bold 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0 0 0 8.35pt; text-align: justify">Restatement of the Statement of Cash
Flows</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0 20.25pt 0 0; text-align: justify">&#160;</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0 20.25pt 0 8.35pt; text-align: justify">IAS 29 sets forth that all the items
of this section shall be restated in terms of the current measurement unit at the closing date of the reported period.</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0; text-align: left">&#160;</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0 20.1pt 0 8.35pt; text-align: justify">The monetary result generated by cash
and equivalents to cash are stated in the Statement of Cash Flows separately from the cash flows resulting from operation, investment
and financing activities as a specific item of the conciliation between the existence of cash and cash equivalents at the beginning and
at the end of the period.</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0; text-align: left">&#160;</p>

<table cellpadding="0" cellspacing="0" style="font: bold 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; width: 100%; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0"><tr style="vertical-align: top">
<td style="width: 8.35pt"/><td style="width: 27pt">2.2.</td><td style="text-align: left">Summary of material accounting policies</td></tr></table>

<p style="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0; text-align: left"><b>&#160;</b></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0 20.2pt 0 8.4pt; text-align: justify">The following are the material accounting
policies applied by the Group in preparing its consolidated financial statements.</p>

</ix:nonNumeric><ix:nonNumeric contextRef="From2024-01-01to2024-12-31" escape="true" id="Fact001131" name="CEPU:DescriptionOfAccountingPolicyForClassificationOfItemsAsCurrentAndNoncurrentExplanatory"><p id="xdx_849_ecustom--DescriptionOfAccountingPolicyForClassificationOfItemsAsCurrentAndNoncurrentExplanatory_zf5YH0l6GXW7" style="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0 20.2pt 0 8.4pt; text-align: justify">&#160;</p>

<table cellpadding="0" cellspacing="0" style="font: bold 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; width: 100%; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0"><tr style="vertical-align: top">
<td style="width: 8.4pt"/><td style="width: 35.25pt"><span style="letter-spacing: -0.05pt">2.2.1.</span></td><td style="text-align: left"><span id="xdx_86F_zmvE7sfK7lld">Classification of items as current and non-current</span></td></tr></table>

<p style="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0; text-align: left"><b>&#160;</b></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0 20.25pt 0 8.4pt; text-align: justify">The Group classifies assets and liabilities
in the consolidated statement of financial position as current and non-current. An entity shall classify an asset as current when:</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0 20.25pt 0 8.4pt; text-align: justify">&#160;</p>

<table cellpadding="0" cellspacing="0" style="font: 11pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; width: 100%; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0"><tr style="vertical-align: top">
<td style="width: 9.45pt"/><td style="width: 18pt"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#8211;</span></td><td style="text-align: left"><span style="font-size: 10pt">it expects to realize the asset, or intends to sell or consume it, in its normal
operating cycle;</span></td></tr></table>

<p style="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0 0 0 27.45pt; text-align: left; text-indent: 0in">&#160;</p>

<table cellpadding="0" cellspacing="0" style="font: 11pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; width: 100%; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0"><tr style="vertical-align: top">
<td style="width: 9.45pt"/><td style="width: 18pt"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#8211;</span></td><td style="text-align: left"><span style="font-size: 10pt">it holds the asset primarily for the purpose of trading;</span></td></tr></table>

<p style="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0; text-align: left">&#160;</p>

<table cellpadding="0" cellspacing="0" style="font: 11pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; width: 100%; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0"><tr style="vertical-align: top">
<td style="width: 9.45pt"/><td style="width: 18pt"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#8211;</span></td><td style="text-align: left"><span style="font-size: 10pt">it expects to realize the asset within twelve months after the reporting period;
or</span></td></tr></table>

<p style="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0 0 0 27.45pt; text-align: left; text-indent: 0in">&#160;</p>

<table cellpadding="0" cellspacing="0" style="font: 11pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; width: 100%; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0"><tr style="vertical-align: top">
<td style="width: 9.45pt"/><td style="width: 18pt"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#8211;</span></td><td style="text-align: left; padding-right: 20.2pt"><span style="font-size: 10pt">the asset is cash or a cash equivalent unless the asset
is restricted from being exchanged or used to settle a liability for at least twelve months after the reporting period.</span></td></tr></table>

<p style="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0; text-align: left">&#160;</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0 0 0 8.35pt; text-align: justify">All other assets are classified as non-current.
An entity shall classify a liability as current when:</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0 0 0 8.35pt; text-align: justify">&#160;</p>

<table cellpadding="0" cellspacing="0" style="font: 11pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; width: 100%; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0"><tr style="vertical-align: top">
<td style="width: 9.45pt"/><td style="width: 18pt"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#8211;</span></td><td style="text-align: left"><span style="font-size: 10pt">it is expected to be settled in normal operating cycle;</span></td></tr></table>

<p style="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0; text-align: left">&#160;</p>

<table cellpadding="0" cellspacing="0" style="font: 11pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; width: 100%; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0"><tr style="vertical-align: top">
<td style="width: 9.45pt"/><td style="width: 18pt"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#8211;</span></td><td style="text-align: left"><span style="font-size: 10pt">It is held primarily for the purpose of trading;</span></td></tr></table>

<p style="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0; text-align: left">&#160;</p>

<table cellpadding="0" cellspacing="0" style="font: 11pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; width: 100%; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0"><tr style="vertical-align: top">
<td style="width: 9.45pt"/><td style="width: 18pt"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#8211;</span></td><td style="text-align: left"><span style="font-size: 10pt">it is due to be settled within twelve months after the reporting period; or</span></td></tr></table>

<p style="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0 0 0 27.45pt; text-align: left; text-indent: 0in">&#160;</p>

<table cellpadding="0" cellspacing="0" style="font: 11pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; width: 100%; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0"><tr style="vertical-align: top">
<td style="width: 9.45pt"/><td style="width: 18pt"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#8211;</span></td><td style="text-align: left; padding-right: 20.2pt"><span style="font-size: 10pt">there is no unconditional right to defer the settlement
of the liability for at least twelve months after the reporting period.</span></td></tr></table>

<p style="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0; text-align: left">&#160;</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0 0 0 8.35pt; text-align: justify">All other liabilities are classified as
non-current.</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0 0 0 8.35pt; text-align: justify">&#160;</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0 0 0 8.35pt; text-align: justify">Deferred tax assets and liabilities are
classified as non-current assets and liabilities, in all cases.</p>

</ix:nonNumeric><ix:nonNumeric contextRef="From2024-01-01to2024-12-31" escape="true" id="Fact001133" name="ifrs-full:DescriptionOfAccountingPolicyForFairValueMeasurementExplanatory"><p id="xdx_846_eifrs-full--DescriptionOfAccountingPolicyForFairValueMeasurementExplanatory_zSyjkLf5RYLk" style="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0; text-align: left">&#160;</p>

<table cellpadding="0" cellspacing="0" style="font: bold 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; width: 100%; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0"><tr style="vertical-align: top">
<td style="width: 8.35pt"/><td style="width: 35.3pt"><span style="letter-spacing: -0.05pt">2.2.2.</span></td><td style="text-align: left"><span id="xdx_862_z9yEXcz9NBc5">Fair value measurement</span></td></tr></table>

<p style="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0; text-align: left"><b>&#160;</b></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0 20.3pt 0 8.35pt; text-align: justify">The Group measures certain financial
instruments at their fair value at each reporting date. In addition, the fair value of financial instruments measured at amortized cost
is disclosed in Note 13.5.</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0 20.3pt 0 8.35pt; text-align: justify">&#160;</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0 20.25pt 0 8.35pt; text-align: justify">Fair value is the price that would
be received to sell an asset or paid to transfer a liability in an orderly transaction between market participants at the measurement
date. The fair value measurement is based on the presumption that the transaction to sell the asset or transfer the liability takes place
either:</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0; text-align: left">&#160;</p>

<table cellpadding="0" cellspacing="0" style="font: 11pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; width: 100%; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0"><tr style="vertical-align: top">
<td style="width: 9.45pt"/><td style="width: 18pt"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#8211;</span></td><td style="text-align: left"><span style="font-size: 10pt">in the principal market for the asset or liability, or</span></td></tr></table>

<p style="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0 0 0 9.45pt; text-align: left">&#160;</p>

<table cellpadding="0" cellspacing="0" style="font: 11pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; width: 100%; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0"><tr style="vertical-align: top">
<td style="width: 9.45pt"/><td style="width: 18pt"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#8211;</span></td><td style="text-align: left"><span style="font-size: 10pt">in the absence of a principal market, in the most advantageous market for the
asset or liability.</span></td></tr></table>

<p style="margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0">&#160;</p>


<ix:exclude><!-- Field: Page; Sequence: 325 -->
