<p style="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0 20.05pt 0 8.4pt; text-align: justify">As of December 31, 2024, the Group
holds tax loss carry-forward in its subsidiaries for <span id="xdx_906_ecustom--TaxLossCarryForwards_iI_pn3n3_c20241231_zyJjdqTPVXK2" title="Tax loss carry forwards"><ix:nonFraction name="CEPU:TaxLossCarryForwards" contextRef="AsOf2024-12-31" id="Fact002715" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="-3" scale="3" unitRef="ARS">40,418,329</ix:nonFraction></span> that could be utilized against future taxable profit from such entities.
Nevertheless, the Group considered there is no certainty regarding the existence of future taxable income against which tax loss carry-forward
for an amount of <span id="xdx_905_ecustom--TaxLossCarryForwardNotRecognizedAsDeferredTaxAsset_iI_pn3n3_c20241231_zPqUX6klPNH1" title="Tax loss carry-forward for an amount"><ix:nonFraction name="CEPU:TaxLossCarryForwardNotRecognizedAsDeferredTaxAsset" contextRef="AsOf2024-12-31" id="Fact002717" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="-3" scale="3" unitRef="ARS">4,126,809</ix:nonFraction></span> can be applied. Therefore, the corresponding deferred tax asset has not been recognized.</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0; text-align: left">&#160;</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0 20.1pt 0 8.4pt; text-align: justify">Earnings per share amounts are calculated
by dividing net income for the year attributable to equity holders of the parent by the weighted average number of ordinary shares during
the year, net of the number of treasury shares.</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0; text-align: left">&#160;</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0 20.1pt 0 8.4pt; text-align: justify">There are no transactions or items generating
an effect of dilution.</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0.05pt 0 0; text-align: left">&#160;</p>

</ix:nonNumeric><p id="xdx_8A3_zVwxOhD4xDl2" style="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0 20.15pt 0 8.35pt; text-align: justify">&#160;</p>

<p style="font: bold 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0 0 0 8.4pt; text-align: justify">Concession right of Piedra del &#193;guila
hydroelectric power plant</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0.05pt 0 0; text-align: left">&#160;</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0 20.15pt 0 8.35pt; text-align: justify">Includes the amounts paid as consideration
for rights relating to the concession of Piedra del &#193;guila hydroelectric power plant awarded by the Argentine government for a
30-year term, from the date of taking possession of such hydroelectric complex. The concession term terminated on December 29, 2023 and
it was extended to a maximum date of December 28, 2025 (see Note 1.2.l).</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0; text-align: left">&#160;</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0 20.15pt 0 8.35pt; text-align: justify">For a concession arrangement to fall
within the scope of IFRIC 12, usage of the infrastructure must be controlled by the concession grantor. This requirement is met when the
following two conditions are met:</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0; text-align: left">&#160;</p>

<table cellpadding="0" cellspacing="0" style="font: 11pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; width: 100%; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0"><tr style="vertical-align: top">
<td style="width: 9.45pt"/><td style="width: 18pt"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#8211;</span></td><td style="text-align: left; padding-right: 20.2pt"><span style="font-size: 10pt">the grantor controls or regulates what services the
operator must provide with the infrastructure, to whom it must provide them, and at what price; and</span></td></tr></table>

<p style="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0; text-align: left">&#160;</p>

<table cellpadding="0" cellspacing="0" style="font: 11pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; width: 100%; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0"><tr style="vertical-align: top">
<td style="width: 9.45pt"/><td style="width: 18pt"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#8211;</span></td><td style="text-align: left; padding-right: 20.2pt"><span style="font-size: 10pt">the grantor controls the infrastructure, i.e., retains
the right to take back the infrastructure at the end of the concession.</span></td></tr></table>

<p style="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0; text-align: left">&#160;</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0 20.2pt 0 8.35pt; text-align: justify">Upon Resolution 95 passed by Argentine
government the Company&#180;s concession right of Piedra del &#193;guila hydroelectric power plant met both conditions above.</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0; text-align: left">&#160;</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0 0 0 8.35pt; text-align: justify">The main features of the concession contract
are as follows:</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0; text-align: left">&#160;</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0 0 0 8.35pt; text-align: justify"><b>Control and regulation of prices by concession
grantor: </b>Pricing schedule approved by grantor;</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0 0 0 8.35pt; text-align: left"><b>Remuneration paid by: </b>CAMMESA;</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0 0 0 8.35pt; text-align: left">&#160;</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0 20.05pt 0 8.35pt; text-align: justify"><b>Grant or guarantee from concession
grantor:</b> None;</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0 20.05pt 0 8.35pt; text-align: justify">&#160;</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0.05pt 0 0 8.35pt; text-align: left"><b>Residual value: </b>Infrastructure
returned to grantor for no consideration at end of concession;</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0.05pt 0 0 8.35pt; text-align: left">&#160;</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0 20.05pt 0 8.35pt; text-align: justify"><b>Concession end date: </b>maximum
date December 28, 2025 (see Note 1.2.l);</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0 20.05pt 0 8.35pt; text-align: justify"><b>&#160;</b></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0 20.05pt 0 8.35pt; text-align: justify"><b>IFRIC 12 accounting model: </b>Intangible
asset.</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0 20.05pt 0 8.35pt; text-align: justify">&#160;</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0 20.05pt 0 8.35pt; text-align: justify"><b>Fees and royalties: </b>the Intergovernmental
Basin Authority is entitled to a fee of 2.5% of the plant&#8217;s revenues, and the provinces of Rio Negro and Neuqu&#233;n are entitled
to royalties of 12% of such revenues. For the years ended December 31, 2024 and 2023, the fees and royalties amounted to <span id="xdx_908_ecustom--FeesAndRoyalties_pn3n3_c20240101__20241231_z87eXkvro1Vd" title="Fees and royalties"><ix:nonFraction name="CEPU:FeesAndRoyalties" contextRef="From2024-01-01to2024-12-31" id="Fact003167" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="-3" scale="3" unitRef="ARS">6,932,243</ix:nonFraction></span> and
<span id="xdx_909_ecustom--FeesAndRoyalties_pn3n3_c20230101__20231231_zTmIw7dkLsn7" title="Fees and royalties"><ix:nonFraction name="CEPU:FeesAndRoyalties" contextRef="From2023-01-012023-12-31" id="Fact003169" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="-3" scale="3" unitRef="ARS">8,789,811</ix:nonFraction></span>, respectively and they were shown in operating expenses in the consolidated statement of income.</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0 20.05pt 0 8.35pt; text-align: justify">&#160;</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0 20.05pt 0 8.35pt; text-align: justify">Contractual capital investment obligations
and obligations relating to maintenance expenditure on infrastructure under concession are not significant.</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0 20.05pt 0 8.35pt; text-align: justify">&#160;</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0 20.05pt 0 8.35pt; text-align: justify"><b>Transmission lines of wind farms
Achiras, La Castellana, La Genoveva, La Genoveva II and Manque</b></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0 20.05pt 0 8.35pt; text-align: justify">&#160;</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0 20.05pt 0 8.35pt; text-align: justify">The Group finished the construction
of wind farms La Castellana, Achiras, La Genoveva, La Genoveva II and Manque, whereby the Group agreed to build high and medium tension
lines and the electrical substation to connect the wind farms to Sistema Argentino de Interconexi&#243;n ("SADI"), a part
of which were given to the companies transporting the energy; therefore, such companies are in charge of the maintenance of such transferred
installations. Consequently, the Group recognized intangible assets for the works related to the construction of the described equipments.</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0 20.05pt 0 8.35pt; text-align: justify">&#160;</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0 20.05pt 0 8.35pt; text-align: justify"><b>Turbogas and turbosteam supply
agreements for Brigadier Lopez thermoelectric power plant</b></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0 20.05pt 0 8.35pt; text-align: justify">&#160;</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0 20.05pt 0 8.35pt; text-align: justify">During fiscal year 2019, as a result
of the business combination related to the acquisition of Brigadier Lopez thermoelectric power plant, the Group recognized an intangible
asset related to turbogas and turbosteam supply agreements entered into with CAMMESA regarding Brigadier Lopez thermoelectric power plant.</p>

<p style="font: 11pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0; text-align: left"><b>&#160;</b></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0 20.05pt 0 8.35pt; text-align: justify">Trade receivables from CAMMESA accrue
interest, once they become due.</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0.05pt 0 0; text-align: left">&#160;</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0 20.05pt 0 8.35pt; text-align: justify">The Company accrues interests on CVO
receivables since the Commercial Approval date and according to the rate agreed in the CVO agreement, as described in Note 1.2.a).</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0.05pt 0 0; text-align: left">&#160;</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0 20.05pt 0 8.35pt; text-align: justify">Trade receivables related to large
users accrue interest as stipulated in each individual agreement. The average collection term is generally from 30 to 90 days.</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0.05pt 0 0; text-align: left">&#160;</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0 20.05pt 0 8.35pt; text-align: justify"><b>CVO receivables</b></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0.05pt 0 0; text-align: left">&#160;</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0 20.05pt 0 8.35pt; text-align: justify">As described in Note 1.2.a), in 2010
the Company approved the &#8220;CVO agreement&#8221; and as from March 20, 2018, CAMMESA granted the &#8220;Commercial Approval&#8221;.</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0.05pt 0 0; text-align: left">&#160;</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0 20.05pt 0 8.35pt; text-align: justify">Receivables under CVO agreement are
disclosed under &#8220;Trade receivables - CAMMESA&#8221;.</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0.05pt 0 0; text-align: left">&#160;</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0 20.05pt 0 8.35pt; text-align: justify">As a consequence of the Commercial
Approval and in accordance with the CVO agreement, the Company collects the CVO receivables converted in US dollars in 120 equal and consecutive
installments.</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0.05pt 0 0; text-align: left">&#160;</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0 20.05pt 0 8.35pt; text-align: justify">CVO receivables are expressed in USD
and they accrued LIBOR interest at a 5% rate. Due to the fact that as from June 30, 2023, the calculation and publication of the LIBO
rate were suspended, for the purpose of determining the applicable interest this rate has been replaced by the Secured Overnight Financing
Rate (SOFR) published by the CME (Chicago Mercantile Exchange) plus a fixed spread of <span id="xdx_90D_ecustom--FixedInterestRate_iI_pip0_dp_c20241231_zg2W9zneuAFk" title="Fixed interest rate"><ix:nonFraction name="CEPU:FixedInterestRate" contextRef="AsOf2024-12-31" id="Fact003229" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="INF" scale="-2" unitRef="Pure">0.11448</ix:nonFraction></span>%.</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0.05pt 0 0; text-align: left">&#160;</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0 20.05pt 0 8.35pt; text-align: justify">During the years ended December 31,
2024, 2023 and 2022, collections of CVO receivables belonging to CPSA amounted to <span id="xdx_901_ecustom--ReceivablesCollections_pn3n3_c20240101__20241231__ifrs-full--ClassesOfFinancialAssetsAxis__custom--CVOreceivablesMember_zLrQvn5p0Duk" title="Receivables collections"><ix:nonFraction name="CEPU:ReceivablesCollections" contextRef="From2024-01-012024-12-31_custom_CVOreceivablesMember" id="Fact003231" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="-3" scale="3" unitRef="ARS">79,625,354</ix:nonFraction></span>, <span id="xdx_902_ecustom--ReceivablesCollections_pn3n3_c20230101__20231231__ifrs-full--ClassesOfFinancialAssetsAxis__custom--CVOreceivablesMember_zHoohh91gVUa" title="Receivables collections"><ix:nonFraction name="CEPU:ReceivablesCollections" contextRef="From2023-01-012023-12-31_custom_CVOreceivablesMember" id="Fact003233" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="-3" scale="3" unitRef="ARS">80,432,228</ix:nonFraction></span> and <span id="xdx_903_ecustom--ReceivablesCollections_pn3n3_c20220101__20221231__ifrs-full--ClassesOfFinancialAssetsAxis__custom--CVOreceivablesMember_zlLJql1vNrV8" title="Receivables collections"><ix:nonFraction name="CEPU:ReceivablesCollections" contextRef="From2022-01-012022-12-31_custom_CVOreceivablesMember" id="Fact003235" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="-3" scale="3" unitRef="ARS">84,133,970</ix:nonFraction></span>, respectively.
Also, collections of CVO receivables corresponding to the company Central Costanera S.A. amounted to <span id="xdx_90A_ecustom--ReceivablesCollections_pn3n3_c20240101__20241231__ifrs-full--ClassesOfFinancialAssetsAxis__custom--CVOReceivablesOneMember_zeIZWOl3m5Mj" title="Receivables collections"><ix:nonFraction name="CEPU:ReceivablesCollections" contextRef="From2024-01-012024-12-31_custom_CVOReceivablesOneMember" id="Fact003237" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="-3" scale="3" unitRef="ARS">4,036,843</ix:nonFraction></span> during the year ended December

<p style="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0.05pt 0 0; text-align: left">&#160;</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0 20.05pt 0 8.35pt; text-align: justify">The information on the Group&#8217;s
objectives and credit risk management policies is included in Note 19.</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0.05pt 0 0; text-align: left">&#160;</p>

<td style="width: 8.4pt"/><td style="width: 35.75pt"><span style="letter-spacing: -0.05pt">13.3.1.&#160;</span></td><td style="text-align: left">Loans from the IIC-IFC Facility</td></tr></table>


<p style="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0; text-align: left">&#160;</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0 20.05pt 0 8.35pt; text-align: justify">On October 20, 2017 and January 17,
2018, CP La Castellana S.A.U. and CP Achiras S.A.U. (both of which are subsidiaries of CPR), respectively, agreed on the structuring of
a series of loan agreements in favor of CP La Castellana S.A.U. and CP Achiras S.A.U., for a total amount of USD <span id="xdx_901_ecustom--LoanPrincipal_iI_uUSD_c20171020__ifrs-full--ClassesOfFinancialInstrumentsAxis__custom--CPLACastellanaSAUSAUMember_zmjLAmxcN98" title="Loans amounts"><ix:nonFraction name="CEPU:LoanPrincipal" contextRef="AsOf2017-10-20_custom_CPLACastellanaSAUSAUMember" id="Fact003360" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="0" unitRef="USD">100,050,000</ix:nonFraction></span> and USD <span id="xdx_904_ecustom--LoanPrincipal_iI_uUSD_c20180117__ifrs-full--ClassesOfFinancialInstrumentsAxis__custom--CPAchirasSAUMember_zYwiQhBttU5a" title="Loan amounts"><ix:nonFraction name="CEPU:LoanPrincipal" contextRef="AsOf2018-01-17_custom_CPAchirasSAUMember" id="Fact003362" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="0" unitRef="USD">50,700,000</ix:nonFraction></span>,
respectively, with: (i) International Finance Corporation (IFC) on its own behalf, as Eligible Hedge Provider and as an implementation
entity of the Intercreditor Agreement Managed Program; (ii) Inter-American Investment Corporation (&#8220;IIC&#8221;), as lender on its
behalf, acting as agent for the Inter-American Development Bank (&#8220;IDB&#8221;) and on behalf of IDB as administrator of the Canadian
Climate Fund for the Private Sector in the Americas (&#8220;C2F&#8221;, and together with IIC and IDB, &#8220;Group IDB&#8221;, and together
with IFC, &#8220;Senior Creditors&#8221;).</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0; text-align: left">&#160;</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0 20.05pt 0 8.35pt; text-align: justify">In accordance with the terms of the
agreement subscribed by CP La Castellana S.A.U., USD <span id="xdx_90E_eifrs-full--Accruals_iI_pn6n6_uUSD_c20190215__ifrs-full--ClassesOfFinancialInstrumentsAxis__custom--CPLACastellanaSAUSAUMember_zMF3X01XXdAc" title="Accrued amount"><ix:nonFraction name="ifrs-full:Accruals" contextRef="AsOf2019-02-15_custom_CPLACastellanaSAUSAUMember" id="Fact003364" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="-6" scale="6" unitRef="USD">5</ix:nonFraction></span> million accrue an interest rate equal to LIBOR plus <span id="xdx_908_ecustom--LiborPlusRate_iI_pip0_dp_c20190215__ifrs-full--ClassesOfFinancialInstrumentsAxis__custom--CPLACastellanaSAUSAUMember_zGnjkXFDKNp6" title="LIBOR plus rate"><ix:nonFraction name="CEPU:LiborPlusRate" contextRef="AsOf2019-02-15_custom_CPLACastellanaSAUSAUMember" id="Fact003366" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="INF" scale="-2" unitRef="Pure">3.5</ix:nonFraction></span>%, and the rest at LIBOR
plus <span id="xdx_903_ecustom--RemainingLiborPlusRate_iI_pip0_dp_c20190215__ifrs-full--ClassesOfFinancialInstrumentsAxis__custom--CPLACastellanaSAUSAUMember_z1qwMENfWDQb" title="Remaining LIBOR plus rate"><ix:nonFraction name="CEPU:RemainingLiborPlusRate" contextRef="AsOf2019-02-15_custom_CPLACastellanaSAUSAUMember" id="Fact003368" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="INF" scale="-2" unitRef="Pure">5.25</ix:nonFraction></span>%, until August 15, 2023. As a consequence of the suspension of the LIBOR rate, which occurred on June 30, 2023, CP La Castellana
S.A.U., together with IDB Group and IFC amended the loan agreements on June 29, 2023, replacing the LIBOR rate with the Secured Overnight
Financing Rate (SOFR) plus a fixed Credit Adjustment Spread (CAS) of 0.26161% applicable from August 15, 2023. The loan is amortizable
quarterly in 52 equal and consecutive installments starting February 15, 2019.</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0; text-align: left">&#160;</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0 20.05pt 0 8.35pt; text-align: justify">In accordance with the terms of the
agreement subscribed by CP Achiras, USD <span id="xdx_908_eifrs-full--Accruals_iI_pn5n6_uUSD_c20190515__ifrs-full--ClassesOfFinancialInstrumentsAxis__custom--CPAchirasSAUMember_zcATMqDg5S05" title="Accrued amount"><ix:nonFraction name="ifrs-full:Accruals" contextRef="AsOf2019-05-15_custom_CPAchirasSAUMember" id="Fact003370" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="-5" scale="6" unitRef="USD">40.7</ix:nonFraction></span> million accrue a fixed interest rate equal to <span id="xdx_901_ecustom--FixedInterestRate_iI_pip0_dp_c20190515__ifrs-full--ClassesOfFinancialInstrumentsAxis__custom--CPAchirasSAUMember_zs5d80vmJRId" title="Fixed interest rate"><ix:nonFraction name="CEPU:FixedInterestRate" contextRef="AsOf2019-05-15_custom_CPAchirasSAUMember" id="Fact003372" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="INF" scale="-2" unitRef="Pure">8.05</ix:nonFraction></span>%, and the rest accrue a <span id="xdx_905_ecustom--RemainingFixedInterestRate_iI_pip0_dp_c20190515__ifrs-full--ClassesOfFinancialInstrumentsAxis__custom--CPAchirasSAUMember_zCP9UGrzKZTf" title="Remaining fixed interest rate"><ix:nonFraction name="CEPU:RemainingFixedInterestRate" contextRef="AsOf2019-05-15_custom_CPAchirasSAUMember" id="Fact003374" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="INF" scale="-2" unitRef="Pure">6.77</ix:nonFraction></span>% fixed interest
rate. The loan is amortizable quarterly in 52 equal and consecutive installments starting May 15, 2019.</p>

<ix:exclude><p id="xdx_238_zsSouYIMWik6" style="font: bold 12pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 4.1pt 16.05pt 0 4.25pt; text-align: center">CENTRAL PUERTO S.A.</p></ix:exclude>

<ix:exclude><p id="xdx_23F_zdoUNb1mkNz4" style="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0; text-align: left">&#160;</p></ix:exclude>

<ix:exclude><p id="xdx_238_zXYUd7qm9e6" style="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0.35pt 0 0; text-align: left">&#160;</p></ix:exclude>

<p style="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0 20.05pt 0 8.35pt; text-align: justify">As per the executed loan agreement
and among other obligations undertaken, the subsidiaries CP La Castellana and CP Achiras have committed to maintain a Historical Senior
Debt Service Coverage Ratio of at least 1.20:1.00 until the project&#8217;s termination date. Such ratio is calculated by dividing the
addition of EBITDA for the most recent four financial quarters prior to the calculation date by the amount of all scheduled debt payments
due in those four quarters.</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0 20.05pt 0 8.35pt; text-align: justify">&#160;</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0 20.05pt 0 8.35pt; text-align: justify">In addition, as a guarantee of the
obligations undertaken, the subsidiaries CP La Castellana and CP Achiras have a pledge in favor of IFC and IIC with a first degree recording
on the financed assets.</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0 20.05pt 0 8.35pt; text-align: justify">&#160;</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0 20.05pt 0 8.35pt; text-align: justify">Other related agreements and documents,
such as the Guarantee and Sponsor Support Agreement (the &#8220;Guarantee Agreement&#8221; by which CPSA completely, unconditionally and
irrevocably guaranted, as the main debtor, all payment obligations undertaken by CP La Castellana and CP Achiras until the projects reach
the commercial operations date) hedging agreements, guarantee trusts, a mortgage, guarantee agreements on shares, guarantee agreements
on wind turbines, direct agreements and promissory notes have been signed.</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0 20.05pt 0 8.35pt; text-align: justify">&#160;</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0 20.05pt 0 8.35pt; text-align: justify">As of February 16, 2023, CP La Castellana
and CP Achiras have fulfilled all the requirements and conditions to certify the occurrence of the project&#8217;s compliance date. As
a result, the Guarantee Agreement posted by CPSA was released.</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0 20.05pt 0 8.35pt; text-align: justify">&#160;</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0 20.05pt 0 8.35pt; text-align: justify">The Company also agreed to maintain,
unless otherwise consented to in writing by each senior lender, ownership and control of the CP La Castellana and CP Achiras as follows:
(i) until each project completion date, (a) it shall maintain (x) directly or indirectly, at least seventy percent (70%) beneficial ownership
of CP La Castellana and CP Achiras; and (y) control of the CP La Castellana and CP Achiras; and (b) CP Renovables shall maintain (x) directly,
ninety-five percent (95%) beneficial ownership of CP La Castellana and CP Achiras; and (y) control of CP La Castellana and CP Achiras.
In addition, (ii) after each project completion date, (a) we shall maintain (x) directly or indirectly, at least fifty and one tenth percent
(50.1%) beneficial ownership of each of CP La Castellana, CP Achiras and CP Renovables; and (y) control of each of CP La Castellana, CP
Achiras and CP Renovables; and (b) CP Renovables shall maintain control of CP La Castellana and CP Achiras. Finally, there are certain
requirements to be fulfilled in order to distribute dividends from CP La Castellana and CP Achiras.</p>

into a loan agreement with KfW for an amount of up to USD <span id="xdx_90E_ecustom--LoanPrincipal_iI_pn6n6_uUSD_c20190526__ifrs-full--ClassesOfFinancialInstrumentsAxis__custom--KreditanstaWiederaufbauMember_zOLB12CqzlK3" title="Loans amounts"><ix:nonFraction name="CEPU:LoanPrincipal" contextRef="AsOf2019-05-26_custom_KreditanstaWiederaufbauMember" id="Fact003387" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="-6" scale="6" unitRef="USD">56</ix:nonFraction></span> million to finance the acquisition of two gas turbines, equipment and related

<td style="width: 8.4pt"/><td style="width: 35.75pt"><span style="letter-spacing: -0.05pt">13.3.3.</span></td><td style="text-align: left">Loan from Citibank N.A., JP Morgan Chase Bank N.A. and Morgan Stanley Senior Funding INC.</td></tr></table>

<p style="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 10.35pt 20.1pt 0 8.4pt; text-align: justify">On June 12, 2019, the Company
entered into a loan agreement with Citibank N.A., JP Morgan Chase Bank N.A. and Morgan Stanley Senior Funding INC. for USD 180 million
to fund the acquisition of the Thermal Station Brigadier L&#243;pez.</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 10.35pt 20pt 0 8.35pt; text-align: justify">According to the terms of the agreement,
this loan accrued at a variable interest rate based on the LIBO rate plus a margin. Due to the suspension of the LIBO rate on June 30,
2023, the Company and Citibank N.A., JP Morgan Chase Bank N.A. and Morgan Stanley Senior Funding INC amended the loan agreement on August
16, 2023, replacing the LIBO rate with the Secured Overnight Financing Rate (SOFR) plus a Credit Adjustment Spread (CAS) of 0.26161% applicable
from September 12, 2023.</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 10.3pt 20.05pt 0 8.4pt; text-align: justify">Considering the restrictions imposed
by the Argentine Central Bank (&#8220;BCRA&#8221;) described in Note 22, two amendments to the loan agreement were entered into on December
22, 2020 and June 15, 2021 to modify the amortization calendar to comply with BCRA requirements. As part of such amendments, the applicable
interest rates were increased by 200 basic points and then by 125 basic points, and limitations were established for the payment of dividends
as follows: no dividends could be paid during 2021, only up to USD <span id="xdx_908_ecustom--DividendRestriction_pn6n6_uUSD_c20220101__20221231__ifrs-full--ClassesOfFinancialInstrumentsAxis__custom--JPMorganChaseBankNAAndMorganStanleySeniorFundingINCMember_zwgb5OKSSIY4" title="Dividend restriction"><ix:nonFraction name="CEPU:DividendRestriction" contextRef="From2022-01-012022-12-31_custom_JPMorganChaseBankNAAndMorganStanleySeniorFundingINCMember" id="Fact003397" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="-6" scale="6" unitRef="USD">25</ix:nonFraction></span> million could be paid during 2022, and only up to USD <span id="xdx_905_ecustom--DividendRestriction_pn6n6_uUSD_c20230101__20231231__ifrs-full--ClassesOfFinancialInstrumentsAxis__custom--JPMorganChaseBankNAAndMorganStanleySeniorFundingINCMember_zGzkkRlc3TJ7" title="Dividend restriction"><ix:nonFraction name="CEPU:DividendRestriction" contextRef="From2023-01-012023-12-31_custom_JPMorganChaseBankNAAndMorganStanleySeniorFundingINCMember" id="Fact003399" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="-6" scale="6" unitRef="USD">20</ix:nonFraction></span> million
could be paid during 2023.</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 10.45pt 20.05pt 0 8.35pt; text-align: justify">On October 19, 2023, the Company
prepaid principal for an amount of USD <span id="xdx_90B_ecustom--PrepaidPrincipalAmount_iI_uUSD_c20231019__ifrs-full--ClassesOfFinancialInstrumentsAxis__custom--JPMorganChaseBankNAAndMorganStanleySeniorFundingINCMember_ziVVnXHwvDb2" title="Prepaid principal amount"><ix:nonFraction name="CEPU:PrepaidPrincipalAmount" contextRef="AsOf2023-10-19_custom_JPMorganChaseBankNAAndMorganStanleySeniorFundingINCMember" id="Fact003401" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="0" unitRef="USD">49,043,078</ix:nonFraction></span>, under the terms and conditions of the loan agreement. Since then, the principal owed
amounted to USD <span id="xdx_907_ecustom--PrepaidPrincipalAmount_iI_uUSD_c20240131__ifrs-full--ClassesOfFinancialInstrumentsAxis__custom--JPMorganChaseBankNAAndMorganStanleySeniorFundingINCMember_zgIDNf8LobX2" title="Prepaid principal amount"><ix:nonFraction name="CEPU:PrepaidPrincipalAmount" contextRef="AsOf2024-01-31_custom_JPMorganChaseBankNAAndMorganStanleySeniorFundingINCMember" id="Fact003403" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="0" unitRef="USD">6,056,922</ix:nonFraction></span> due in January 2024. This way, more than 80% of the loan was repaid. Therefore, as from that date, the dividend
payment limitation from this loan was no longer effective.</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 10.3pt 20.2pt 0 8.4pt; text-align: justify">As of December 31, 2023, the balance
of this loan amounted to <span id="xdx_901_eifrs-full--Borrowings_iI_pn3n3_c20231231__ifrs-full--ClassesOfFinancialInstrumentsAxis__custom--JPMorganChaseBankNAAndMorganStanleySeniorFundingINCMember_z5PbxZ10xkC1" title="Borrowings"><ix:nonFraction name="ifrs-full:Borrowings" contextRef="AsOf2023-12-31_custom_JPMorganChaseBankNAAndMorganStanleySeniorFundingINCMember" id="Fact003405" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="-3" scale="3" unitRef="ARS">10,708,306</ix:nonFraction></span>. The loan balance has been fully repaid at its due date.</p>

<table cellpadding="0" cellspacing="0" style="font: bold 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; width: 100%; margin-top: 10.35pt; margin-bottom: 0"><tr style="vertical-align: top">
<td style="width: 8.4pt"/><td style="width: 35.75pt"><span style="letter-spacing: -0.05pt">13.3.4.</span></td><td style="text-align: left">Loan from the IFC to the subsidiary Vientos La Genoveva S.A.U.</td></tr></table>

<p style="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 10.35pt 20.2pt 0 8.4pt; text-align: justify">On June 21, 2019, Vientos La Genoveva
S.A.U., a CPSA subsidiary, signed a loan agreement with IFC on its own behalf, as Eligible Hedge Provider and as an implementation entity
of the Managed Co-Lending Portfolio Program (MCPP) administered by IFC, for an amount of USD <span id="xdx_909_ecustom--LoanPrincipal_iI_pn5n6_uUSD_c20190621__ifrs-full--ClassesOfFinancialInstrumentsAxis__custom--VientosLaGenovevaSAUMember_zsY6Aw8dmPAj" title="Loans amounts"><ix:nonFraction name="CEPU:LoanPrincipal" contextRef="AsOf2019-06-21_custom_VientosLaGenovevaSAUMember" id="Fact003407" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="-5" scale="6" unitRef="USD">76.1</ix:nonFraction></span> million.</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 10.4pt 20.1pt 0 8.4pt; text-align: justify">Pursuant to the terms of the agreement
signed with Vientos La Genoveva S.A.U., this loan accrued an interest rate equal to LIBOR plus <span id="xdx_902_ecustom--LiborPlusRate_iI_pip0_dp_c20230815__ifrs-full--ClassesOfFinancialInstrumentsAxis__custom--VientosLaGenovevaSAUMember_ziEx5Bug9CSl" title="LIBOR plus rate"><ix:nonFraction name="CEPU:LiborPlusRate" contextRef="AsOf2023-08-15_custom_VientosLaGenovevaSAUMember" id="Fact003409" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="INF" scale="-2" unitRef="Pure">6.50</ix:nonFraction></span>% until August 15, 2023. As a consequence
of the suspension of the LIBOR rate, which occurred on June 30, 2023, Vientos La Genoveva S.A.U. together with IFC amended this agreement
on June 14, 2023, replacing the LIBOR rate with the Secured Overnight Financing Rate (SOFR) plus a fixed Credit Adjustment Spread (CAS)
of 0.26161% applicable from August 15, 2023. The loan is amortizable quarterly in 55 installments starting November 15, 2020.</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 10.3pt 20.1pt 0 8.4pt; text-align: justify">As per the executed loan agreement
and among other obligations undertaken, the subsidiary Vientos La Genoveva S.A.U. has committed to maintain a Historical Senior Debt Service
Coverage Ratio of at least 1.20:1.00 until the project&#8217;s termination date. Such ratio is calculated by dividing the addition of
EBITDA for the most recent four financial quarters prior to the calculation date by the amount of all scheduled debt payments due in those
four quarters.</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 10.3pt 20.1pt 0 8.4pt; text-align: justify">In addition, as a guarantee of
the obligations undertaken, the subsidiary Vientos La Genoveva S.A.U. has a pledge in favor of IFC with a first degree recording on the
financed assets.</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 10.4pt 20.1pt 0 8.35pt; text-align: justify">Other related agreements and documents,
such as the Guarantee and Sponsor Support Agreement (the &#8220;Guarantee Agreement&#8221; by which CPSA fully, unconditionally and irrevocably
guarantees, as the main debtor, all payment obligations undertaken by Vientos La Genoveva S.A.U until the project reaches the commercial
operations date) hedging agreements, guarantee trusts, guarantee agreements on shares, guarantee agreements on wind turbines, direct agreements
and promissory notes have been signed.</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 10.4pt 20.2pt 0 8.35pt; text-align: justify">Pursuant to the Guarantee Agreement,
among other customary covenants for this type of facilities, CPSA had committed, until the project completion date, to maintain (i) a
leverage ratio of not more than 3.5:1.00; and (ii) an interest coverage ratio of not less than 2.00:1.00. In addition, CPSA, upon certain
conditions, agreed to make certain equity contributions to Vientos La Genoveva S.A.U.</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 10.45pt 20.05pt 0 8.4pt; text-align: justify">On May 24, 2019, CPR Energy Solutions
S.A.U. (subsidiary of CPR) signed a loan agreement with Banco de Galicia y Buenos Aires S.A. for an amount of USD 12.5 million to fund
the construction of the wind farm &#8220;La Castellana II&#8221;.</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 10.3pt 20pt 0 8.4pt; text-align: justify">According to the executed agreement,
this loan accrues a fixed interest rate equal to <span id="xdx_901_eifrs-full--BorrowingsInterestRate_iI_pip0_dp_c20200524__ifrs-full--ClassesOfFinancialInstrumentsAxis__custom--CPREnergySolutionsSAUMember_zgSKIQ5FYaQ2" title="Borrowings interest rate"><ix:nonFraction name="ifrs-full:BorrowingsInterestRate" contextRef="AsOf2020-05-24_custom_CPREnergySolutionsSAUMember" id="Fact003422" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="INF" scale="-2" unitRef="Pure">8.5</ix:nonFraction></span>% during the first year, which will be increased by <span id="xdx_909_ecustom--IncreasedInterestRate_iI_pip0_dp_c20200524__ifrs-full--ClassesOfFinancialInstrumentsAxis__custom--CPREnergySolutionsSAUMember_z8MbET5mQrP6" title="Interest rate increased"><ix:nonFraction name="CEPU:IncreasedInterestRate" contextRef="AsOf2020-05-24_custom_CPREnergySolutionsSAUMember" id="Fact003424" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="INF" scale="-2" unitRef="Pure">0.5</ix:nonFraction></span>% per annum until the sixty-first
interest period. The loan is amortizable quarterly in 25 installments starting May 24, 2020.</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 10.35pt 20.05pt 0 8.35pt; text-align: justify">As per the executed loan agreement,
the subsidiary CPR Energy Solutions S.A.U. has committed to maintain: (i) a financial debt and EBITDA ratio lower than 2.25, and (ii)

subsidiary obtained waivers to comply with the mentioned ratios and other contractual obligations in relation to the wind farm incident
expenses included in Other operating expenses of the income statement for the year ended December 31, 2024. Finally, there are certain
requirements that such subsidiary must fulfill for dividend payments.</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 10.35pt 20.2pt 0 8.4pt; text-align: justify">In addition, as a guarantee of
the obligations undertaken, the subsidiary CPR Energy Solutions S.A.U. has a pledge in favor of Banco de Galicia y Buenos Aires S.A. with
a first degree recording on the financed assets.</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 11.45pt 20.05pt 0 8.35pt; text-align: justify">On July 31, 2020, the Special

value issued: USD <span id="xdx_903_ecustom--BondsIssuedClassA_uUSD_c20230916__20230917_z7IvIM1pGDvf" title="Bonds issued face value Class A"><ix:nonFraction name="CEPU:BondsIssuedClassA" contextRef="From2023-09-162023-09-17" id="Fact003459" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="0" unitRef="USD">37,232,818</ix:nonFraction></span>, ii) interest rate, determined by bidding: 7%, iii) periodicity of the interest coupon: semi-annual, iv)
amortization: bullet, v) term: 30 months to be counted as from September 17, 2023 and vi) applicable law and deposit place: Argentina,
Caja de Valores S.A. On the other hand, on October 17, 2023, subscription and settlement of the international bond denominated &#8220;10%
Senior Notes due 2025&#8221; (Class B CB) took place. Such bond is denominated, paid-in and payable in US dollars abroad, under the Reg
S scheme. The characteristics of this bond are the following: i) face value issued: USD <span id="xdx_90D_ecustom--BondsIssuedClassB_uUSD_c20230916__20230917_zQNzytJMS4C9" title="Bonds issued face value Class B"><ix:nonFraction name="CEPU:BondsIssuedClassB" contextRef="From2023-09-162023-09-17" id="Fact003461" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="0" unitRef="USD">50,000,000</ix:nonFraction></span>, ii) interest rate, determined by bidding:
10%, iii) periodicity of the interest coupon: semi-annual, iv) amortization: bullet, v) term: 24 months to be counted as from October
17, 2023 and vi) applicable law and deposit place: New York, Euroclear.</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0.05pt 0 0; text-align: left">&#160;</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0 20.05pt 0 8.35pt; text-align: justify">Finally, on October 20, 2023, the
Company decided to reopen the Class A CB. This procedure allows the Company to offer in the market security which replicates the conditions
of the security already offered, incorporating the interest rate determined in the original offer (7%) and bidding the price. As a result
of this process, the Company issued an additional USD <span id="xdx_903_ecustom--AdditionalBondsIssuedFaceValueClassA_uUSD_c20231017__20231020_zKRnETYmAO12" title="Additional bonds issued face value Class A"><ix:nonFraction name="CEPU:AdditionalBondsIssuedFaceValueClassA" contextRef="From2023-10-172023-10-20" id="Fact003463" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="0" unitRef="USD">10,000,000</ix:nonFraction></span> for the Class A CB, with an issuance price of 102.9%.</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0.05pt 0 0; text-align: left">&#160;</p>

<table cellpadding="0" cellspacing="0" style="font: bold 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; width: 100%; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0"><tr style="vertical-align: top">
<td style="width: 8.35pt"/><td style="width: 40.3pt"><span style="letter-spacing: -0.05pt">13.3.10.</span></td><td style="text-align: left">CPSA&#180;s Shares Buyback Program</td></tr></table>

<p style="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 11.4pt 20.1pt 0 8.35pt; text-align: justify">On August 24, 2023, the Company's
Board of Directors approved the creation of a new program for the acquisition of the shares issued by the Company as per the regulations
in force, for a maximum amount of up to USD 10,000,000 or the lowest amount resulting from the acquisition until reaching 10% of the share
capital and for a 180-calendar-day period counted as from the business day following the publication of the purchase in the market&#8217;s
media, which shall be subject to any term renewal or extension.</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0.05pt 0 0; text-align: left">&#160;</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0 20.2pt 0 8.35pt; text-align: justify">The acquisition procedures may be conducted
by the Company and/or its subsidiaries with a daily limit for operations of up to <span id="xdx_90A_ecustom--AnnualFixedRate_iI_pip0_dp_c20241231__ifrs-full--ClassesOfFinancialInstrumentsAxis__custom--CPSASharesBuybackProgramMember_zBu2eB0iSB64" title="Annual fixed percentage rate"><ix:nonFraction name="CEPU:AnnualFixedRate" contextRef="AsOf2024-12-31_custom_CPSASharesBuybackProgramMember" id="Fact003465" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="INF" scale="-2" unitRef="Pure">25</ix:nonFraction></span>% of the average volume of daily transactions for
the share in the markets in which it is listed, considering to such end the previous 90 trading business days. <span id="xdx_901_ecustom--SharePriceDescription_c20240101__20241231__ifrs-full--ClassesOfFinancialInstrumentsAxis__custom--CPSASharesBuybackProgramMember_zZNjkVa8qafe" title="Share price description"><ix:nonNumeric contextRef="From2024-01-012024-12-31_custom_CPSASharesBuybackProgramMember" id="Fact003467" name="CEPU:SharePriceDescription">The maximum price to be
paid for the shares is USD 8 per American Depositary Receipt (&#8220;ADR&#8221;) in the NYSE and up to a maximum of ARS 605 per share
in BYMA, which was increased to ARS 800 per share as per the decision of the Company's Board of Directors on October 17, 2023.</ix:nonNumeric></span> As of December
31, 2024, the Group acquired <span id="xdx_90E_ecustom--SharesPurchaseDuringPeriod_c20240101__20241231__ifrs-full--ClassesOfFinancialInstrumentsAxis__custom--CPSASharesBuybackProgramMember_zqxrCkb8DLZ2" title="Share purchase during period"><ix:nonFraction name="CEPU:SharesPurchaseDuringPeriod" contextRef="From2024-01-012024-12-31_custom_CPSASharesBuybackProgramMember" id="Fact003469" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="INF" unitRef="Shares">2,552,027</ix:nonFraction></span> of its own shares under the program for a total amount of <span id="xdx_90C_ecustom--SharePurchaseValueDuringPeriod_pn3n3_c20240101__20241231__ifrs-full--ClassesOfFinancialInstrumentsAxis__custom--CPSASharesBuybackProgramMember_zt1xKH9DL299" title="Share purchase value during period"><ix:nonFraction name="CEPU:SharePurchaseValueDuringPeriod" contextRef="From2024-01-012024-12-31_custom_CPSASharesBuybackProgramMember" id="Fact003471" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="-3" scale="3" unitRef="ARS">1,316,069</ix:nonFraction></span>.</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0.05pt 0 0; text-align: left">&#160;</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0.05pt 20.2pt 0 8.35pt; text-align: justify">The transactions conducted through
this program have been recorded as acquisitions of treasury shares in accordance with IAS 32. Therefore, the consideration paid for such
shares was directly recorded against Equity under the &#8220;Other equity accounts&#8221; item.</p>

<td style="width: 8.35pt"/><td style="width: 40.3pt"><span style="letter-spacing: -0.05pt">13.3.11.</span></td><td style="text-align: left">Mitsubishi Corporation Loan</td></tr></table>

<p style="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0.05pt 0 0; text-align: left"><b>&#160;</b></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0 20.1pt 0 8.35pt; text-align: justify">On November 29, 1996, the Company Central
Costanera S.A. entered into an agreement with Mitsubishi Corporation for the installation of a combined cycle power station. The original
agreement included a USD 192.5 million financing for 12 years from the provisional reception of the project, with an annual <span id="xdx_907_ecustom--AnnualFixedRate_iI_pip0_dp_c20241231__ifrs-full--ClassesOfFinancialInstrumentsAxis__custom--MitsubishiCorporationLoanMember_zW9r5RjeX0vf" title="Annual fixed percentage rate"><ix:nonFraction name="CEPU:AnnualFixedRate" contextRef="AsOf2024-12-31_custom_MitsubishiCorporationLoanMember" id="Fact003473" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="INF" scale="-2" unitRef="Pure">7.42</ix:nonFraction></span> % fixed
rate and semiannual capital and interest amortization.</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 10.25pt 20.05pt 0 8.35pt; text-align: justify">As of December 31, 2024, CPSA has
several short-term loans with Banco Santander S.A. (Uruguay) for a total of USD <span id="xdx_903_ecustom--LoanPrincipal_iI_uUSD_c20241231__ifrs-full--ClassesOfFinancialInstrumentsAxis__custom--BancoSantanderS.A.Member_zqgHa21HAk4l" title="Short-term loans"><ix:nonFraction name="CEPU:LoanPrincipal" contextRef="AsOf2024-12-31_custom_BancoSantanderS.A.Member" id="Fact003519" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="0" unitRef="USD">252,899</ix:nonFraction></span> to finance the acquisition of equipment to be
used in the Brigadier Lopez combined cycle closing project. These loans accrue interest at an effective annual rate of between <span id="xdx_90F_ecustom--AnnualRate_iI_pip0_dp_c20241231__ifrs-full--ClassesOfFinancialInstrumentsAxis__custom--BancoSantanderS.A.Member__ifrs-full--RangeAxis__ifrs-full--BottomOfRangeMember_zOPFfIbAoYL5" title="Annual rate"><ix:nonFraction name="CEPU:AnnualRate" contextRef="AsOf2024-12-31_custom_BancoSantanderS.A.Member_ifrs-full_BottomOfRangeMember" id="Fact003521" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="INF" scale="-2" unitRef="Pure">7</ix:nonFraction></span>% and
<span id="xdx_90A_ecustom--AnnualRate_iI_pip0_dp_c20241231__ifrs-full--ClassesOfFinancialInstrumentsAxis__custom--BancoSantanderS.A.Member__ifrs-full--RangeAxis__ifrs-full--TopOfRangeMember_zKqUQOie84a5" title="Annual rate"><ix:nonFraction name="CEPU:AnnualRate" contextRef="AsOf2024-12-31_custom_BancoSantanderS.A.Member_ifrs-full_TopOfRangeMember" id="Fact003523" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="INF" scale="-2" unitRef="Pure">8</ix:nonFraction></span>%, with maturities between January 9, 2025, and April 30, 2025.</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 10.25pt 20.05pt 0 8.35pt; text-align: justify">On November 4, 2024, the subsidiary

(Uruguay) for a total of USD <span id="xdx_90E_ecustom--LoanPrincipal_iI_uUSD_c20241104__ifrs-full--ClassesOfFinancialInstrumentsAxis__custom--BancoSantanderS.A.Member_zoNLjVs5lkVg" title="Short-term loans"><ix:nonFraction name="CEPU:LoanPrincipal" contextRef="AsOf2024-11-04_custom_BancoSantanderS.A.Member" id="Fact003525" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="0" unitRef="USD">36,318</ix:nonFraction></span> to finance the import of
materials and equipment. This loan accrues interest at an effective annual rate of <span id="xdx_902_ecustom--AnnualRate_iI_pip0_dp_c20241104__ifrs-full--ClassesOfFinancialInstrumentsAxis__custom--BancoSantanderS.A.Member_z7HLw8jOv11c" title="Annual rate"><ix:nonFraction name="CEPU:AnnualRate" contextRef="AsOf2024-11-04_custom_BancoSantanderS.A.Member" id="Fact003527" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="INF" scale="-2" unitRef="Pure">7</ix:nonFraction></span>%, with a scheduled maturity date of <span id="xdx_909_ecustom--DebtInstrumentMaturityDates_dd_c20241103__20241104__ifrs-full--ClassesOfFinancialInstrumentsAxis__custom--BancoSantanderS.A.Member_zCzyGfmZ1Qjg" title="Maturity date"><ix:nonNumeric contextRef="From2024-11-032024-11-04_custom_BancoSantanderS.A.Member" format="ixt:datemonthdayyearen" id="Fact003529" name="CEPU:DebtInstrumentMaturityDates">May 5, 2025</ix:nonNumeric></span>.</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0 20.1pt 0 8.35pt; text-align: justify">The &#8220;Non-cash transactions&#8221;
column includes the income for exposure to change in purchasing power of currency (income on net monetary position), which amounted to
<span id="xdx_90E_ecustom--NonCashTransactionsIncludesIncomeForExposureToChangeInPurchasingPowerOfCurrency_iI_pn3n3_c20241231_zO3pzV5sky5b" title="Non-cash transactions includes income for exposure to change in purchasing power of currency"><ix:nonFraction name="CEPU:NonCashTransactionsIncludesIncomeForExposureToChangeInPurchasingPowerOfCurrency" contextRef="AsOf2024-12-31" id="Fact003589" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="-3" scale="3" unitRef="ARS">418,228,652</ix:nonFraction></span> and <span id="xdx_901_ecustom--NonCashTransactionsIncludesIncomeForExposureToChangeInPurchasingPowerOfCurrency_iI_pn3n3_c20231231_z66ctHg1z2Hj" title="Non-cash transactions includes income for exposure to change in purchasing power of currency"><ix:nonFraction name="CEPU:NonCashTransactionsIncludesIncomeForExposureToChangeInPurchasingPowerOfCurrency" contextRef="AsOf2023-12-31" id="Fact003591" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="-3" scale="3" unitRef="ARS">478,210,563</ix:nonFraction></span> as of December 31, 2024 and 2023, respectively. The &#8220;Other&#8221; column includes the effect of reclassification
of non- current portion to current due to the passage of time, the foreign exchange movement and the effect of accrued but not yet paid
interest. The Group classifies interest paid as cash flows from financing activities.</p>

<p style="font: bold 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0 0 0 8.35pt; text-align: justify">Valuation techniques</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 11.45pt 20.15pt 0 8.35pt; text-align: justify">The fair value reported in connection
with the abovementioned financial assets and liabilities is the amount at which the instrument could be exchanged in a current transaction
between willing parties, other than in a forced or liquidation sale. The following methods and assumptions were used to estimate the fair
values:</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0.05pt 0 0; text-align: left">&#160;</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0.05pt 20.15pt 0 8.35pt; text-align: justify">Management assessed that the
fair values of current trade receivables approximate their carrying amounts largely due to the short-term maturities of these instruments.</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 11.45pt 20.1pt 0 8.35pt; text-align: justify">The Group measures long-terms
receivables at fixed and variable rates based on discounted cash flows. The valuation requires that the Group adopt certain assumptions
such as interest rates, specific risk factors of each transaction and the creditworthiness of the customer.</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0.05pt 0 0; text-align: left">&#160;</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0.05pt 20.1pt 0 8.35pt; text-align: justify">Fair value of quoted debt securities,
mutual funds, stocks and corporate bonds is based on price quotations at the end of each reporting period.</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 11.45pt 0 0 8.35pt; text-align: justify">Fair value of loans and borrowings
approximates their book value.</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0; text-align: left">&#160;</p>

<p style="font: bold 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0.05pt 0 0 8.35pt; text-align: justify">Fair value hierarchy</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 11.4pt 20.05pt 0 8.35pt; text-align: justify">The following tables provides,
by level within the fair value measurement hierarchy, as described in Note 2.2.2, the Company&#8217;s financial assets, that were measured
at fair value on recurring basis as of December 31, 2024 and 2023:</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0; text-align: left">&#160;</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0 40.3pt 0 8.65pt; text-align: left">There were no transfers between hierarchies
and there were not significant variations in assets values.</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0 40.3pt 0 0; text-align: left">&#160;</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0 40.3pt 0 8.65pt; text-align: left">The information on the Group&#8217;s objectives
and financial risk management policies is included in Note 19.</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0 20pt 0 8.35pt; text-align: justify">Within the framework of the amendment
to the loan agreement with Citibank N.A., JP Morgan Chase Bank N.A. and Morgan Stanley Senior Funding INC -described in Note 13.3.3-,
there was a restriction for the payment of dividends until 80% of the loan&#8217;s principal and interests were paid. Thus, during 2021
no dividends could be paid, while during 2022 and 2023 dividends could be paid up to USD 25 million and USD 20 million, respectively.
Due to the advanced partial payment of the balance of such loan on October 19, 2023 as described in Note 13.3.3, through which more than
80% of the loan was paid, this limitation was no longer applicable as from that date.</p>

CP La Castellana S.A.U., CPR Energy Solutions S.A.U., Vientos La Genoveva II S.A.U., Central Costanera S.A. and Vientos La Genoveva S.A.U.
in order for them to distribute dividends.</p>

during fiscal years initiated on or after January 1, 2018, that are to be paid to Argentine resident individuals and/or non-Argentine
residents, are subject to a <span id="xdx_906_eifrs-full--ApplicableTaxRate_pip0_dp_c20171231__20180101_zZHeuIYCvXfb" title="Income tax rate"><ix:nonFraction name="ifrs-full:ApplicableTaxRate" contextRef="From2017-12-312018-01-01" id="Fact004227" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="INF" scale="-2" unitRef="Pure">7</ix:nonFraction></span>% income tax withholding on the amount of such dividends.</p>

assets, liabilities, rights, and obligations of CPR as of the effective date of the merger. </ix:nonNumeric><ix:nonNumeric contextRef="From2024-01-01to2024-12-31" escape="true" id="Fact004577" name="ifrs-full:DisclosureOfFinancialRiskManagementExplanatory"><p id="xdx_804_eifrs-full--DisclosureOfFinancialRiskManagementExplanatory_zdZ5XQ5FLspa" style="font: 11pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0; text-align: left"><b>&#160;</b></p>

<table cellpadding="0" cellspacing="0" style="font: bold 11pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; width: 100%; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0"><tr style="vertical-align: top">
<td style="width: 8.4pt"/><td style="width: 21.5pt"><span style="letter-spacing: -0.05pt">19.</span></td><td style="text-align: left"><span id="xdx_820_zEtXAcYThBLh">Financial risk management objectives and policies</span></td></tr></table>

<p style="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0; text-align: left">&#160;</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0 0 0 9.45pt; text-align: left">&#8211;	Interest rate risk</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0 20.15pt 0 0; text-align: justify">&#160;</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0 20.15pt 0 8.4pt; text-align: justify">Interest rate variations affect the
value of assets and liabilities accruing a fixed interest rate, as well as the flow of financial assets and liabilities with floating
interest rates.</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0 20.15pt 0 0; text-align: justify">&#160;</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0 20.05pt 0 8.35pt; text-align: justify">The Company&#180;s risk administration
policy is defined for the purposes of reducing the effect of the purchasing power loss. During most of 2024 and 2023 net monetary positions
have been assets; hence, during such period the Company sought to mitigate the risk by implementing adjustment mechanisms through interest
and exchange differences. Consequently, during 2024 and 2023, item Loss on net monetary position registered a net loss due to inflation-exposure
of monetary items.</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0 20.05pt 0 0; text-align: justify">&#160;</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0 0 0 8.4pt; text-align: justify"><i>Interest rate sensitivity</i></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0 20.15pt 0 0; text-align: justify">&#160;</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0 20.15pt 0 8.65pt; text-align: justify">The following table shows the sensitivity
of income before income tax for the year ended December 31, 2024, to a reasonably possible change in interest rates over the portion of
loans bearing interest at a variable interest rate, with all other variables held constant:</p>

<ix:exclude><p id="xdx_23F_zdqhyuVp6jn" style="font: bold 12pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 4.1pt 16.05pt 0 4.25pt; text-align: center">CENTRAL PUERTO S.A.</p></ix:exclude>

<ix:exclude><p id="xdx_239_zcFUP895HQMk" style="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0 20.25pt 0 0; text-align: justify">&#160;</p></ix:exclude>

<ix:exclude><p id="xdx_23C_zZ6BZr1EQnde" style="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0 20.25pt 0 0; text-align: justify">&#160;</p></ix:exclude>

<p style="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0 0 0 9.45pt; text-align: left">&#8211;	Foreign currency risk</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0 20.1pt 0 0; text-align: justify">&#160;</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0 20.1pt 0 8.4pt; text-align: justify">Foreign currency risk is the risk that
the fair value or future cash flows of a financial instrument will fluctuate because of changes in foreign exchange rates.</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0 20.1pt 0 0; text-align: justify">&#160;</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0 20.1pt 0 8.4pt; text-align: justify">The Company is exposed to the foreign
currency risk at an ARS/USD ratio, mainly due to its operating activities, the investment projects defined by the Company and the financial
debt related to the bank loans mentioned in Note 13.3. The Company does not use derivative financial instruments to hedge such risk. As
of December 31, 2024, the net balance exposed to this risk amounts to USD <span id="xdx_903_ecustom--ForeignCurrencyLiabilities_iI_pn3n3_uUSD_c20241231_zFkTAAgdQ0v3" title="Foreign currency liabilities"><ix:nonFraction name="CEPU:ForeignCurrencyLiabilities" contextRef="AsOf2024-12-31" id="Fact004588" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="-3" scale="3" unitRef="USD">17,214</ix:nonFraction></span> thousand, as existing foreign currency liabilities of
USD <span id="xdx_904_ecustom--AccountsReceivablesInForeignCurrency_iI_pn3n3_uUSD_c20241231_z4zjh1OXDYok" title="Accounts receivables in foreign currency"><ix:nonFraction name="CEPU:AccountsReceivablesInForeignCurrency" contextRef="AsOf2024-12-31" id="Fact004590" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="-3" scale="3" unitRef="USD">429,380</ix:nonFraction></span> thousand exceed accounts receivables, other financial assets, and cash and short- term deposits in foreign currency of USD
<span id="xdx_906_ecustom--ShortTermAssetsInForeignCurrency_iI_pn3n3_uUSD_c20241231_zmUM31OxG4cg" title="Short-term assets in foreign currency"><ix:nonFraction name="CEPU:ShortTermAssetsInForeignCurrency" contextRef="AsOf2024-12-31" id="Fact004592" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="-3" scale="3" unitRef="USD">412,166</ix:nonFraction></span> thousand.</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0; text-align: left">&#160;</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0 0 0 8.4pt; text-align: justify"><i>Foreign currency sensitivity</i></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0; text-align: left"><i>&#160;</i></p>

to a reasonably possible change in the US dollar exchange rate, with all other variables held constant, of income before income tax as
of December 31, 2024 (due to changes in the fair value of monetary assets and liabilities).</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0.35pt 0 0; text-align: left">&#160;</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0; text-align: left">&#160;</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0 20.05pt 0 8.4pt; text-align: justify">The Company&#8217;s revenues depend
on the electric power price in the spot market paid by CAMMESA. The Company has no power to set prices in the market where it operates,
except for the income from agreements entered into in the Term Market, where the price risk is reduced since normally prices are negotiated
above the spot market price.</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0; text-align: left">&#160;</p>

<p style="font: bold 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0 0 0 8.4pt; text-align: justify">Credit risk</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0; text-align: left"><b>&#160;</b></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0 20.05pt 0 8.4pt; text-align: justify">Credit risk is the risk that a counterparty
will not meet its obligations under a financial instrument or customer contract, leading to a financial loss. The Company is exposed to
credit risk from its operating activities (primarily for trade receivables) and from its financing activities, including holdings of government
securities.</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0 20.05pt 0 0; text-align: justify">&#160;</p>

<table cellpadding="0" cellspacing="0" style="font: 11pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; width: 100%; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0"><tr style="vertical-align: top">
<td style="width: 9.45pt"/><td style="width: 18pt"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#8211;</span></td><td style="text-align: left"><span style="font-size: 10pt">Trade and other receivables</span></td></tr></table>

<p style="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0; text-align: left">&#160;</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0 19.95pt 0 8.35pt; text-align: justify">The Finance Department is in charge
of managing customer credit risk subject to policies, procedures and controls relating to the Group&#8217;s credit risk management. Customer
receivables are regularly monitored. Although the Group has received no guarantees, it is entitled to request interruption of electric
power flow if customers fail to comply with their credit obligations. In regard to credit concentration, see Note 13.1. The need to book
impairment is analyzed at the end of each reporting period on an individual basis for major clients. The allowance recorded as of December
31, 2024, is deemed sufficient to cover the potential impairment in the value of trade receivables.</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0 19.95pt 0 0; text-align: justify">&#160;</p>

<table cellpadding="0" cellspacing="0" style="font: 11pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; width: 100%; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0"><tr style="vertical-align: top">
<td style="width: 9.45pt"/><td style="width: 18pt"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#8211;</span></td><td style="text-align: left"><span style="font-size: 10pt">Cash and cash equivalents</span></td></tr></table>

<p style="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0; text-align: left">&#160;</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0 20.1pt 0 8.35pt; text-align: justify">Credit risk from balances with banks
and financial institutions is managed by the Group&#8217;s treasury department in accordance with corporate policy. Investments of surplus
funds are made only with approved counterparties; in this case, the risk is limited because high-credit-rating banks are involved.</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0 20.1pt 0 0; text-align: justify">&#160;</p>

<table cellpadding="0" cellspacing="0" style="font: 11pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; width: 100%; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0"><tr style="vertical-align: top">
<td style="width: 9.45pt"/><td style="width: 18pt"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#8211;</span></td><td style="text-align: left"><span style="font-size: 10pt">Public and corporate securities</span></td></tr></table>

<p style="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0; text-align: left">&#160;</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0 20.2pt 0 8.35pt; text-align: justify">This risk is managed by the Company&#8217;s
finance management according to corporate policies, whereby these types of investments may only be made in first-class companies and in
instruments issued by the federal or provincial governments.</p>

<p style="font: bold 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0 0 0 8.35pt; text-align: justify">Liquidity risk</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 11.45pt 20.05pt 0 8.35pt; text-align: justify">The Group manages its liquidity
to guarantee the funds required to support its business strategy. Short-term financing needs related to seasonal increases in working
capital are covered through short-and medium-term bank credit lines.</p>

</ix:nonNumeric><p id="xdx_8A0_zXFYrDBs2UU8" style="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0.35pt 0 0; text-align: left">&#160;</p>
<p style="font: bold 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0 0 0 8.35pt; text-align: justify">Granted and received guarantees</p>

<p style="font: bold 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0 0 0 8.35pt; text-align: justify">&#160;</p>
<p style="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0 20.1pt 0 8.35pt; text-align: justify">The Group has posted a bank guarantee
to cover the obligations undertaken under the Concession Agreement of Complejo Hidroel&#233;ctrica Piedra del &#193;guila for <span id="xdx_903_ecustom--GuaranteeObligationCurrentCarryingValue_iI_pn3n3_uARS_c20241231_zL1pT9Gfc1Ob" title="Performance obligations amount"><ix:nonFraction name="CEPU:GuaranteeObligationCurrentCarryingValue" contextRef="AsOf2024-12-31" id="Fact004652" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="-3" scale="3" unitRef="ARS">182,303</ix:nonFraction></span>.
Additionally, and as established in PEN Decree No. 718/24 (see Note 1.2.l), the Group provided a surety insurance for the amount of USD
<span id="xdx_90A_ecustom--InsuranceExpenses_iI_pn3n3_uUSD_c20241231_ztYXGBz8RlUl" title="Insurance amount"><ix:nonFraction name="CEPU:InsuranceExpenses" contextRef="AsOf2024-12-31" id="Fact004654" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="-3" scale="3" unitRef="USD">4,500,000</ix:nonFraction></span> as a guarantee for the extension of the Concession Contract with a maximum term until December 28, 2025.</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0; text-align: left">&#160;</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0 20.15pt 0 8.35pt; text-align: justify">On March 19, 2009, the Group entered
into a pledge agreement with the former Secretariat of Energy to secure its obligations in favor of FONINVEMEM trusts by virtue of the
operation and maintenance agreement of the Timb&#250;es and Manuel Belgrano power stations, by which it pledged as a collateral 100%
of the shares in TSM and TMB.</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0; text-align: left">&#160;</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0 20.1pt 0 8.35pt; text-align: left">On the other hand, shares acquired by
the Group in Central Costanera S.A. have a pledge for which the Group will follow the procedure to achieve its extinguishment.</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 11.5pt 20.1pt 0 8.35pt; text-align: left">Regarding the agreement described
in Note 13.3.13., the Group has granted T-BILLs as compliance guarantee for USD <span id="xdx_90A_eifrs-full--OtherCurrentFinancialAssets_iI_pn5n6_uUSD_c20241231_zosPaS05Asf" title="Non-current other assets"><ix:nonFraction name="ifrs-full:OtherCurrentFinancialAssets" contextRef="AsOf2024-12-31" id="Fact004656" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="-5" scale="6" unitRef="USD">42.1</ix:nonFraction></span> million, which are included under current other financial
assets.</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0.05pt 0 0; text-align: left">&#160;</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0 20.1pt 0 8.35pt; text-align: left">Furthermore, the Group has carried out
stock market guarantees, being these financial operations guaranteed with short-term negotiable securities in local currency.</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0 20.15pt 0 0; text-align: justify">&#160;</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0 20.15pt 0 8.35pt; text-align: justify">Likewise, the Group entered into various
guarantee agreements to provide performance assurance of its obligations arising from the agreements described in Notes 1.2.a), 13.3.1,
13.3.4, 13.3.5, 13.3.6, 13.3.11 and 20.3.</p>

<td style="width: 8.35pt"/><td style="width: 31.35pt">20.2.</td><td style="text-align: justify">Acquisition of General Electric gas turbine</td></tr></table>

<p style="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0.05pt 0 0; text-align: left"><b>&#160;</b></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0 20.3pt 0 8.35pt; text-align: justify">On March 13th, 2015, the Company acquired
a gas turbine from General Electric and hired their specialized technical support services. The unit is a gas turbine with 373 MW output
power.</p>

<table cellpadding="0" cellspacing="0" style="font: bold 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; width: 100%; margin-top: 11.45pt; margin-bottom: 0"><tr style="vertical-align: top">
<td style="width: 8.35pt"/><td style="width: 31.35pt">20.3.</td><td style="text-align: justify">Renewable Energy generation farms</td></tr></table>

<p style="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0.05pt 0 0; text-align: left"><b>&#160;</b></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0 20.15pt 0 8.35pt; text-align: justify">In 2017 the Group entered into a power
purchase agreement with CAMMESA for La Castellana and Achiras wind farms for a 20-year term as from the launch of the commercial operations.
Likewise, during 2018 the Group entered into a power purchase agreement with CAMMESA for La Genoveva wind farm for a 20-year term as from
the launch of the commercial operations.</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0; text-align: left">&#160;</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0 19.85pt 0 8.35pt; text-align: justify">Regarding wind farm La Castellana
II, the Group entered into supply agreements with Rayen Cura S.A.I.C. for a 7-year term and approximately 35,000 MWh/year volume, with
Metrive S.A. for a 15-year term and 12,000 MWh/year volume, with N. Ferraris for a 10-year term and 6,500 MWh/year volume and with Banco
de Galicia y Buenos Aires S.A. for a 10-year term to supply energy demand for approximately 4,700 MWh/year.</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0; text-align: left">&#160;</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0 20.2pt 0 8.35pt; text-align: justify">Regarding wind farm La Genoveva II,
the Group entered into supply agreements with Aguas y Saneamiento S.A. (AYSA) for a 10-year term from the beginning of operations date
of the wind farm and approximately 87.6 GWh/year volume, with PBB Polisur S.R.L. (Dow Chemical) for a term of 6 years and an estimated
volume of 80 GWh/year, with INC S.A. (Carrefour) for a term of 3 years and an estimated volume of 12 GWh/year, with Farm Frites for a
5-year term and 9.5 GWh/year volume and with BBVA for a 5-year term and 6 GWh/year volume.</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0.05pt 0 0; text-align: left">&#160;</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0 20.1pt 0 8.35pt; text-align: justify">Regarding wind farm Manque, the Group
entered into a power purchase agreement with Cervecer&#237;a y Malter&#237;a Quilmes SAICAyG (&#8220;Quilmes&#8221;) for the wind
farm Manque for a 20-year term as from the launch of the commercial operations and for an estimated volume of 235 GWh per year.</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0; text-align: left">&#160;</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0 20.05pt 0 8.35pt; text-align: justify">Regarding the wind farm Los Olivos,
the Group entered into power purchase agreements with S.A. San Miguel A.G.I.C.I. y F., Minera Alumbrera Limited and SCANIA Argentina S.A.U.
for a 10-year term as from the launch of commercial operations, to supply them 8.7 GWh/year, 27.4 GWh/year and 20.2 GWh/year, respectively.</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0; text-align: left">&#160;</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0 20.05pt 0 8.35pt; text-align: justify">During the year 2018, the subsidiary
company CPCS entered into an agreement with CAMMESA for the purchase of energy generated by the Gua&#241;izuil II A solar farm, for
a period of 20 years from the beginning of operations (see Note 20.7).</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0.1pt 0 0; text-align: left">&#160;</p>

<p style="font: bold 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0 0 0 8.35pt; text-align: justify">Acquisition and operation of wind turbines</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0 20.05pt 0 0; text-align: justify">&#160;</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0 20.05pt 0 8.35pt; text-align: justify">The Group has entered into agreements
with Nordex Windpower S.A. for the operation and maintenance of Achiras and La Castellana wind farms for a 10-year term.</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0.05pt 0 0; text-align: left">&#160;</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0 20.05pt 0 8.35pt; text-align: justify">In addition, the Group has entered
into agreements with Vestas Argentina S.A. for the operation and maintenance of wind farms La Genoveva I until August 30, 2040; La Genoveva
II until May 31, 2039; La Castellana II until May 31, 2039; and Manque and Los Olivos until December 31, 2039.</p>

<table cellpadding="0" cellspacing="0" style="font: bold 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; width: 100%; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0"><tr style="vertical-align: top">
<td style="width: 8.35pt"/><td style="width: 31.35pt">20.4.</td><td style="text-align: left">Acquisition of Brigadier L&#243;pez thermoelectric plant</td></tr></table>

<p style="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0 20pt 0 0; text-align: justify">&#160;</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0 20pt 0 8.4pt; text-align: justify">In the context of a local and foreign
public tender called by Integraci&#243;n Energ&#233;tica Argentina S.A. (&#8220;IEASA&#8221;), which has been awarded to the Company,
on June 14, 2019 the transfer agreement of the production unit that is part of Brigadier L&#243;pez thermoelectric plant and of the
premises on which the plant is located, was signed, including: a) production unit for the plant, which includes personal property, recordable
personal property, facilities, machines, tools, spare parts, and other assets used for the plant operation and use; b) IEASA&#8217;s contractual
position in executed contracts (including turbogas and turbosteam supplying contracts with CAMMESA and the financial trust agreement signed
by IEASA as trustor, among others); c) permits and authorizations in effect related to the plant operation; and d) the labor relationship
with the transferred employees.</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0.1pt 0 0; text-align: left">&#160;</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0 20pt 0 8.4pt; text-align: justify">The plant currently has a Siemens gas
turbine of 280.5 MW. According to the tender specifications and conditions, it is expected to supplement the gas turbine with a boiler
and a steam turbine to reach the closing of the combined cycle, which will generate 420 MW in total.</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0 20pt 0 0; text-align: justify">&#160;</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0 20pt 0 8.4pt; text-align: justify">During February 2024, the agreement with
SACDE on the works, services, and necessary works to close the cycle was agreed on, having the &#8220;notice to proceed&#8221; been granted
on February 26, 2024. The cycle closing works are in progress.</p>
